rows.title: ITAM Analyst (SAM/HAM) - Reston, VA - Hybrid
rows.descriptionText:
We have this W2 Contract opportunity for an ITAM Analyst (SAM/HAM) with our Direct Client in Reston, VA. Please let us know if this is something that interests you.

ITAM Analyst III - Software Asset Management (SAM/HAM) - Req # 5737

Location: Reston, VA - Hybrid

Max Pay Rate: $65/hr W2 (No Benefits) - USC and GC only on W2 at this time.

Duration - 12 months +

This role is hybrid and will report to work in the Reston office because it handles hardware in addition to the software***

Team: InfoSec and Infrastructure

Profile: 5+ year ITAM Analyst with Flexara & hardware management, strong critical thinking and communication skills.

Job Description

The ITAM Analyst III - Software Asset Management supports College Board’s Software Asset Management modernization by managing and improving software contract, entitlement, renewal, usage, ownership, compliance, and vendor data. This role supports software cost optimization, tool rationalization, governed intake, renewal readiness, audit preparation, vendor governance, SAM reporting, and CMDB alignment.

The Analyst III helps ensure software assets are visible, governed, cost-effective, compliant, and aligned to enterprise technology standards. This role partners with ITAM, Procurement, Finance, Security, Legal, Workforce, Endpoint, Support Center, Product, application owners, and vendors to improve software lifecycle governance, reduce unmanaged renewals, support self-service software access, strengthen CMDB alignment, and improve leadership visibility through reliable reporting.

The Analyst III is expected to analyze software data, identify trends and risks, recommend improvements, coordinate with stakeholders, support complex renewals and software reviews, and help improve SAM processes and controls.

The role also requires curiosity and a commitment to keeping up with evolving technology, including SAM platforms, SaaS management tools, Flexera capabilities, automation, AI-enabled productivity tools, software metering, entitlement normalization, CMDB integration, and software governance best practices.

In addition to its primary SAM focus, this role provides Hardware Asset Management (HAM) support at the Reston, VA office, including hardware moves, shipping/receiving coordination, inventory reviews, device recovery efforts, and related physical asset activities.

About The Team

College Board has transformed into a post-Agile organization, embracing DevOps and cloud-native systems, with the goal of improving speed and reliability of service delivery in support of our mission. Our team consists of analysts and engineers with a unique blend of skills and experiences, yet we underline the value of each individual and celebrate the successes of the team.

We provide software, hardware, and technology asset services across the College Board enterprise. We work with teams across the company, including Infrastructure Engineering, Endpoint, Support Center, Workforce, Procurement, Finance, Security, Talent, Product, and vendor partners to provide hardware, software, licensed applications, SaaS tools, and asset lifecycle support.

Embracing a culture of continuous improvement, we collaborate regularly, share ideas, identify operational friction points, and help define the future of our services. Our team is characterized by strong technical skills, positive team culture, focus on delivering value, and commitment to improving workforce readiness, audit readiness, and operational efficiency.

We also prioritize technology and continuous learning by staying current with emerging tools, automation opportunities, AI-enabled solutions, asset management platforms, CMDB practices, and industry trends that help us improve service delivery, strengthen governance, and scale reliable ITAM capabilities across the enterprise.

About The Opportunity

The ITAM Analyst III - Software Asset Management leads operational and analytical work across College Board’s software asset lifecycle. This role helps govern software inventory, license assignments, entitlements, renewals, usage, application ownership, contract records, vendor performance, compliance evidence, software intake, and lifecycle reporting.

The analyst will help advance Software Asset Management modernization by improving data quality, entitlement accuracy, renewal tracking, license visibility, software utilization, compliance readiness, financial transparency, and operational consistency across the software lifecycle. This includes software intake, approval, procurement support, assignment, provisioning coordination, renewal, reclamation, retirement, compliance review, and vendor governance.

This role partners closely with ITAM, Procurement, Finance, Security, Legal, Workforce, Endpoint, Support Center, Product, application owners, vendor partners, and other cross-functional teams to reduce software waste, improve service delivery, strengthen compliance, support reliable workforce operations, and provide leadership with trusted reporting.

This position requires strong analytical thinking, communication, customer service, attention to detail, follow-through, cross-functional coordination, and the ability to work through complex software issues across multiple systems, teams, vendors, and governance processes.

The ITAM Analyst III is expected to apply technology learning in practical ways by leading improvements that reduce manual work, improve software data accuracy, strengthen audit readiness, improve reporting, increase license reuse and reclamation, and enhance the employee software request and fulfillment experience.

This role also supports HAM operations at the Reston, VA office, helping ensure hardware moves, shipping/receiving, inventory reviews, and device recovery activities run smoothly.

Technology and Continuous Learning

The ITAM Analyst III - Software Asset Management is expected to stay current with evolving workplace technology, software asset management practices, automation opportunities, and industry trends. This includes developing and applying knowledge of modern SAM platforms, SaaS management tools, license optimization methods, CMDB data practices, software discovery, software metering, AI-enabled productivity tools, reporting dashboards, vendor management capabilities, and compliance practices.

The Analyst III should bring a learner’s mindset and look for practical ways to apply new tools and technology improvements to reduce manual work, improve data accuracy, strengthen audit readiness, improve software utilization, and enhance the employee software request and fulfillment experience.

Operational Requirement

Ability to support technology inventory reviews, software true-up activities, audit evidence preparation, vendor data validation, renewal reviews, software utilization analysis, and special projects.Ability to support hardware-related activities where software entitlement, device assignment, or endpoint software deployment data is required.Ability to participate in onsite meetings, vendor reviews, audits, operational activities, or cross-functional working sessions as needed.Ability to manage multiple workstreams, prioritize effectively, and escalate risks or blockers before they impact delivery.

Physical / Operational Requirement - HAM Support

Ability to lift, carry, and move technology equipment weighing up to 50 lbs to support shipping and receiving of hardware.Ability to support hardware moves, refresh activities, shipping and receiving coordination, inventory reviews, audits, device recovery efforts, and special projects.Ability to provide off-hours support as needed for hardware moves, refreshes, audits, urgent asset activities, recovery escalations, or special projects.Ability to participate in onsite meetings, vendor reviews, audits, and operational activities at the Reston, VA office as needed.

In This Role, You Will

Manage and improve software asset management activities across the full software lifecycle, including intake, request, approval, procurement support, assignment, entitlement tracking, renewal, reclamation, retirement, and compliance review.Maintain accurate software asset records, including licenses, entitlements, subscriptions, renewals, service agreements, contracts, warranties, vendor contacts, application owners, ownership fields, usage data, and lifecycle information.Track and update software ownership, usage, assignment, entitlement, renewal status, contract terms, license type, and compliance status to improve visibility and governance.Analyze software asset data to identify unused licenses, duplicate applications, renewal risks, data gaps, compliance issues, shadow IT indicators, and cost optimization opportunities.Support software request and fulfillment processes by validating entitlement availability, approval status, licensing requirements, ownership, compliance restrictions, and provisioning readiness.Perform software license reconciliation, usage review, exception reporting, audit evidence gathering, and SLA Health Check activities.Generate and distribute software reports, compliance reports, renewal reports, usage reports, lifecycle status reports, vendor performance reports, and trend analyses to support decision-making across ITAM and Technology teams.Identify software eligible for reclamation, reuse, renewal adjustment, retirement, consolidation, rationalization, or cost optimization.Support vendor governance activities, including software catalog updates, renewal tracking, SLA review, billing accuracy reviews, contract validation, vendor performance reporting, and service performance reporting.Collaborate with ITAM, Procurement, Finance, Security, Legal, Workforce, Endpoint, Support Center, Product, application owners, and vendor teams to resolve software asset issues and improve lifecycle processes.Maintain and improve processes related to software asset management, software compliance, CMDB alignment, vendor governance, software intake, and audit readiness.Identify process gaps and recommend improvements that reduce manual work, improve software data quality, increase automation, and strengthen license governance.Support high-risk vendor and software title reviews by validating licensing compliance, renewal readiness, ownership, usage, security review status, and shadow IT exposure.Keep up with emerging technology, SAM best practices, automation tools, AI-enabled solutions, SaaS management trends, CMDB practices, and software governance capabilities.Contribute to knowledge base articles, process documentation, standard operating procedures, software request guides, reporting guides, and training materials.Provide high-quality internal customer support when responding to software-related requests, incidents, escalations, and inquiries.Provide support for software renewals, audits, true-ups, reclamation efforts, vendor reviews, reporting requests, and special projects as required.Maintain and govern accurate hardware asset records for laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, and monitors — including warranties, service agreements, assignment details, ownership, location, and lifecycle status.Support hardware moves, refresh activities, shipping and receiving coordination, inventory reviews, audits, device recovery efforts, and special projects at the Reston, VA office.Provide off-hours support as needed for hardware moves, refreshes, audits, urgent asset activities, recovery escalations, or special projects.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibility #1: Software Asset Lifecycle Operations and Data Accuracy — 30%

Maintain accurate software asset records across the full lifecycle, including intake, procurement support, approval, assignment, renewal, reclamation, retirement, and compliance review.Track software ownership, application owner, vendor, license type, entitlement, subscription term, renewal date, usage status, contract status, and related software asset information.Perform software asset reconciliation and resolve data discrepancies across systems, reports, tickets, vendor records, procurement files, contract records, CMDB records, and usage dashboards.Analyze software asset data to identify trends, risks, gaps, unused licenses, duplicate tools, upcoming renewals, compliance issues, and opportunities for optimization.Support software lifecycle stages, including request, approval, procurement support, provisioning coordination, license assignment, renewal, reclamation, retirement, and exception handling.Execute and improve processes related to software asset management, software catalog accuracy, license compliance, renewal readiness, and lifecycle governance.Support end users, managers, application owners, and support teams with software asset-related inquiries, ticket updates, entitlement questions, and escalation support.Support special software programs, renewal activities, true-ups, audits, reclamation campaigns, application rationalization efforts, and other business priorities as needed.

Responsibility #2: Software Licensing, Renewals, Compliance, and Optimization — 30%

Track software licenses, subscriptions, entitlements, renewals, service agreements, contracts, maintenance terms, and vendor obligations.Perform software license reconciliation, normalization, usage analysis, entitlement validation, and compliance review activities.Monitor upcoming renewals and partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, Security, application owners, and vendors to support timely renewal decisions.Identify underused, unused, duplicate, expired, over-provisioned, or non-compliant software assets and recommend corrective actions.Support software reclamation efforts by identifying inactive users, validating license usage, coordinating removal or reassignment, and updating software records.Support software request processes by confirming license availability, approval requirements, compliance restrictions, and assignment status.Help maintain a software catalog that supports clear request paths, approved applications, ownership, licensing requirements, and renewal visibility.Contribute to cost optimization by improving software utilization, reducing unnecessary renewals, and supporting consolidation or retirement of redundant applications.

Responsibility #3: Audit, Compliance, Reporting, Vendor Governance, and CMDB Alignment — 25%

Support software audit readiness through evidence gathering, license reconciliation, exception tracking, control validation, and reporting.Perform SLA Health Checks and remediation follow-up for software asset control gaps, entitlement discrepancies, renewal risks, and compliance exceptions.Generate recurring reports on software inventory, license utilization, renewal status, entitlement accuracy, vendor performance, billing accuracy, compliance status, and software exceptions.Support vendor governance activities, including software catalog maintenance, contract review, renewal support, invoice validation, billing accuracy review, and vendor performance reporting.Help ensure software asset data supports financial stewardship, risk management, audit readiness, vendor accountability, lifecycle planning, and operational decision-making.Support CMDB alignment by improving data quality across employee, software entitlement, application ownership, vendor, lifecycle, contract, and access-relevant software records.Monitor software asset trends to identify risks related to unmanaged applications, shadow IT, unused licenses, upcoming renewals, non-compliant software, and data quality gaps.Partner with ITAM leadership and cross-functional teams to improve software governance, reporting accuracy, compliance confidence, and renewal planning.

Responsibility #4: Process Improvement, Automation, Technology Learning, and Team Collaboration — 15%

Provide meaningful contributions to team discussions related to software process improvement, operational strategy, technology adoption, asset governance, and future-state SAM modernization.Identify opportunities to streamline software requests, approval, renewal, reclamation, reporting, compliance, and vendor governance workflows.Support improvements to Jira, ITSM platforms, CMDB, reporting dashboards, software discovery tools, SaaS management tools, vendor reports, and future Software Asset Management platform capabilities.Stay current with software asset management best practices, automation, AI-enabled tools, SaaS management trends, license optimization practices, CMDB practices, and emerging workplace technology.Contribute ideas, documentation, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, and peer support that advance continuous improvement across SAM operations.Communicate effectively, build strong relationships, and help resolve software asset issues collaboratively across ITAM, Procurement, Finance, Security, Legal, Workforce, Endpoint, Support Center, Product, application owners, and vendor teams.Support cross-training peers and resolving software asset issues when first presented without escalation where possible.Support a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, customer service, and operational excellence across Software Asset Management.

Responsibility #5: Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Support — Onsite Reston, VA

The following HAM support tasks are performed at the Reston, VA office alongside this role’s core SAM responsibilities above. They do not carry a separate percentage allocation against the SAM responsibility totals (which remain 100% as defined); rather, this is supplemental scope tied to the role’s onsite HAM presence.

Maintain and govern accurate hardware asset records for laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, and monitors, including warranties, service agreements, assignment details, ownership, location, and lifecycle status.Support hardware moves, refresh activities, shipping and receiving coordination, inventory reviews, audits, device recovery efforts, and special projects.Coordinate with Procurement, vendors, Endpoint, Support Center, Workforce, and ITAM teams for hardware receiving, assignment, shipping, return, storage, and disposal.Provide off-hours support as needed for hardware moves, refreshes, audits, urgent asset activities, recovery escalations, or special projects.

About You

Exceptional candidates can effectively speak to:

Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent experience, in software asset management, technology operations, internal customer support, procurement, licensing, vendor management, or related fields, along with 5-7+ years of experience supporting software asset management, software licensing, SaaS administration, renewal coordination, entitlement tracking, procurement coordination, vendor coordination, or internal technology support.Strong experience managing software records across the full asset lifecycle, including request, approval, procurement support, assignment, renewal, reclamation, retirement, and compliance review.Experience tracking and maintaining accurate records for software licenses, subscriptions, entitlements, renewals, service agreements, contracts, application owners, vendors, users, and compliance status.Ability to analyze software asset data, identify discrepancies, resolve entitlement gaps, document findings, recommend improvements, and follow through on corrective actions.Experience supporting software request, renewal, reclamation, and compliance processes, including usage review, license reassignment, inactive user cleanup, and escalation of renewal or compliance risks.Ability to work collaboratively and tactfully with vendors, suppliers, internal customers, managers, ITAM, Procurement, Finance, Security, Legal, Workforce, Endpoint, Support Center, Product, application owners, and other cross-functional partners.Strong customer service, written communication, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to update tickets, prepare software asset reports, document processes, and explain license or entitlement information clearly.Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning emerging software asset management practices, automation tools, AI-enabled solutions, CMDB practices, SaaS management platforms, software discovery tools, and industry best practices.Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, follow established procedures, escalate risks or blockers appropriately, travel as needed, and contribute to continuous improvement across software asset management operations.Exposure to, or experience supporting, AI-enabled automation, workflow orchestration, or agentic tools within operational or software asset management processes — including understanding the importance of human oversight, data quality, security, privacy, governance, and measurable business outcomes when these solutions are applied.Ability to lift, carry, and move technology equipment weighing up to 50 lbs to support hardware shipping and receiving.Experience with hardware asset management activities, including inventory tracking, device assignment, deployment, refresh, return, recovery, reuse, and disposition, is a plus.Comfort working occasional off-hours or onsite at the Reston, VA office to support hardware moves, refreshes, audits, or device recovery escalations.

Thanks and Regards,

Valerian D’Cunha

Lenmar Consulting Inc (a Kellton Company)

185 Hudson Street, Suite 1440, Jersey City, NJ

D: 201-484-0120

F: 201-946-1790

E: vdcunha@lenmarit.com

Title: Sr. Data Scientist
    Location :    DC Metro Area
    Target Start Date :    ASAP
    Type: contract  
    Pay  Rate: DOE         We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to solve complex business problems through advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI. In this role, you will partner closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering to transform large, complex datasets into actionable insights and production-ready AI solutions. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and excels at communicating complex analytical findings to both technical and executive audiences.      This is a highly collaborative role where you'll drive projects from initial problem definition through model deployment while helping shape the organization's data science and AI strategy.
 
 The ideal candidate is naturally curious, highly analytical, and passionate about applying AI and machine learning to solve meaningful business problems. You enjoy working directly with stakeholders, thrive in collaborative environments, and can confidently bridge the gap between advanced analytics and business strategy. You'll be equally comfortable building production-ready models, communicating with executives, and exploring the latest advancements in Generative AI to drive innovation across the organization. Build and implement Generative AI solutions using large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic AI workflows where appropriate.      Analyze large-scale structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for business optimization.      Develop interactive dashboards and analytical applications using Plotly Dash to communicate insights and support executive decision-making.      Partner with business stakeholders to understand objectives, define success metrics, and translate business requirements into scalable analytical solutions.      Perform statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, experimentation, and model validation to ensure analytical accuracy and reliability.      Deploy machine learning models into cloud environments and collaborate with engineering teams to operationalize AI solutions. Expert-level Python programming skills for data analysis, machine learning, and automation.      Strong experience with Pandas, NumPy, and PySpark for processing and analyzing large datasets.      Advanced SQL skills with experience querying complex relational databases and data warehouses.      Strong foundation in statistics, probability, experimental design, regression, classification, clustering, and hypothesis testing.      Experience designing, training, evaluating, and deploying production machine learning models.      Hands-on experience building interactive dashboards using Plotly and Plotly Dash.      Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for analytics and model deployment.      Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.      Proven ability to manage multiple projects while partnering effectively across business and technical teams. rows.title: Analyst, Venture & Capital Strategy (Johns Hopkins Technology Ventures)
rows.descriptionText:
Johns Hopkins Technology Ventures (JHTV), the university's technology commercialization division, is launching the JHTV Analyst Program, a structured two-year experiential learning opportunity designed for recent graduates interested in innovation, entrepreneurship, healthcare, science, business, law, technology, and public impact.

We are seeking an Analyst, Ventures & Capital Strategy who will contribute to high-priority strategic initiatives while gaining broad exposure to technology commercialization, startup formation, intellectual property, corporate engagement, venture funding, and innovation management. Through cohort-based learning, professional development programming, executive exposure, cross-functional projects, and mentorship, analysts develop the analytical, communication, and leadership skills that prepare them for graduate study or future careers across the innovation economy.

At the end of the two-year term, Analysts may be considered for open positions within JHTV or the university; however, continuation of employment beyond the term is not guaranteed.

The Analyst, Ventures & Capital Strategy will support startup portfolio management, translational funding programs, investor engagement activities, and strategic analysis. Through these efforts, the analyst will gain hands-on exposure to the capital, resources, and commercialization processes that help move Johns Hopkins innovations toward the market. This role provides experience within startup portfolio management and the broader technology commercialization ecosystem.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to support strategic initiatives and organizational priorities.Collect, organize, analyze, and synthesize information from multiple sources to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and recommendations.Develop reports, dashboards, presentations, briefing materials, and executive summaries for operational and strategic decision-making.Support projects involving faculty, university leaders, external partners, and other stakeholders by conducting research, analysis, and developing recommendations.Translate complex information into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences.Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism.Support business process improvement initiatives and recommend enhancements to tools, systems, workflows, and reporting practices.Maintain accurate records, documentation, trackers, and project materials.Build productive relationships across JHTV and the broader university community.Present findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and leadership.Participate in cohort-based onboarding, professional development programming, mentorship opportunities, and cross-functional learning experiences.Contribute to a capstone project and final presentation addressing a strategic opportunity or challenge within JHTV.Support special projects and other duties as assigned.

In addition to duties described above

Conduct market, technical, competitive, and commercial research on emerging technologies.Prepare analyses and presentation materials for interactions with venture capital firms and other external partners.Support the management and analysis of a portfolio of more than 140 startup companies.Develop data-driven insights to inform commercialization strategy and funding decisions.Work closely with faculty innovators, investors, and commercialization professionals.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in a related field.No prior professional experience required.Additional education may substitute for required experience, and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.

Preferred Qualifications

U.S. Citizen or Legal Permanent Resident required due to Federal Export Controls.Advanced degree in a related field.Three years of related experience.Interest in venture capital, startups, or life sciences/technology commercialization.Strong quantitative and analytical skills.Comfort engaging with external partners and investors.Full-time, in-person role based in Baltimore, MD.Fast-paced environment with variable hours; not a fixed 9-to-5 schedule.

Data Management and Analysis - DevelopingBusiness Process Analysis - DevelopingReport Writing - DevelopingPresentations - DevelopingProject Management - DevelopingStakeholder Engagement - DevelopingChange Management - Developing

rows.title: Senior Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Title: Sr. Data Scientist
    Location :    DC Metro Area
    Target Start Date :    ASAP
    Type: contract  
    Pay  Rate: DOE         We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to solve complex business problems through advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI. In this role, you will partner closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering to transform large, complex datasets into actionable insights and production-ready AI solutions. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and excels at communicating complex analytical findings to both technical and executive audiences.      This is a highly collaborative role where you'll drive projects from initial problem definition through model deployment while helping shape the organization's data science and AI strategy.
 
 The ideal candidate is naturally curious, highly analytical, and passionate about applying AI and machine learning to solve meaningful business problems. You enjoy working directly with stakeholders, thrive in collaborative environments, and can confidently bridge the gap between advanced analytics and business strategy. You'll be equally comfortable building production-ready models, communicating with executives, and exploring the latest advancements in Generative AI to drive innovation across the organization.     What You'll Do      Design, develop, validate, and deploy machine learning and statistical models that solve real-world business challenges.      Build and implement Generative AI solutions using large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic AI workflows where appropriate.      Analyze large-scale structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for business optimization.      Develop interactive dashboards and analytical applications using Plotly Dash to communicate insights and support executive decision-making.      Partner with business stakeholders to understand objectives, define success metrics, and translate business requirements into scalable analytical solutions.      Perform statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, experimentation, and model validation to ensure analytical accuracy and reliability.      Deploy machine learning models into cloud environments and collaborate with engineering teams to operationalize AI solutions.      Present findings and recommendations to technical teams, business leaders, and executive stakeholders in a clear, concise manner.      Mentor junior data scientists and contribute to best practices across data science, machine learning, and AI development.      Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend innovative approaches that improve business outcomes.      Required Qualifications      Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline (Master's or PhD preferred).      6 years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied AI, or Advanced Analytics.      Expert-level Python programming skills for data analysis, machine learning, and automation.      Strong experience with Pandas, NumPy, and PySpark for processing and analyzing large datasets.      Advanced SQL skills with experience querying complex relational databases and data warehouses.      Strong foundation in statistics, probability, experimental design, regression, classification, clustering, and hypothesis testing.      Experience designing, training, evaluating, and deploying production machine learning models.      Hands-on experience building interactive dashboards using Plotly and Plotly Dash.      Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for analytics and model deployment.      Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.      Proven ability to manage multiple projects while partnering effectively across business and technical teams.      Preferred Qualifications      Experience developing Generative AI applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases, AI agents, and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.      Experience working with graph databases (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, etc.) and graph analytics.      Knowledge of network analysis, graph algorithms, and knowledge graph architectures.      Experience with MLOps, model monitoring, CI/CD pipelines, and ML lifecycle management.      Experience with distributed computing frameworks and large-scale data platforms.      Experience in financial services, cybersecurity, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries.      Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.      Experience working in Agile development environments using Jira, Git, and modern software engineering practices.      Technical Environment       Programming: Python, SQL       Data Processing: Pandas, PySpark, NumPy       Machine Learning: Scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch (or similar)       Generative AI: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, LangChain, LlamaIndex       Visualization: Plotly, Plotly Dash       Cloud: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud       Databases: SQL, Graph Databases (Neo4j/Neptune preferred)       DevOps & MLOps: Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow (preferred)

rows.title: Manager, Data Scientist - US Card (Upmarket Acquisitions)
rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description 

The US Card Data Science team builds industry leading machine learning models to empower core underwriting decisions in the acquisitions and management of new and existing credit card customers. We collaborate closely with a wide range of cross functional partner teams - data engineers, platforms engineers, product managers, credit and business analysts, to deliver the solutions from ideation to implementation. We are a team of model developers, who own the full life cycle of our models - development, deployment, monitoring, governance, and ongoing usage expansion and releases. We are also a team of creative problem solvers, who challenge the status quo on a continuous basis and are devoted to innovation to keep making our models more dynamic, adaptive, robust, and ultimately, smarter.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analyticsA PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysisAt least 1 year of experience working with machine learningAt least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

Preferred Qualifications:

PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 3 years of experience in data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience working with AWSAt least 4 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R for large scale data analysisAt least 4 years’ experience with machine learningAt least 4 years’ experience with SQL

rows.descriptionText:
Job Summary

This position is located in the Department of Buildings (DOB) The mission of the DOB is to protect the safety of residents, businesses, and visitors and advance the development of the built environment through permitting, inspections, and code enforcement. The incumbent is responsible for reviewing, accessing, and analyzing data and information concerning all operations of DOB as well as understanding all aspects of the operations and impact of DOB across all properties in the District of Columbia that are impacted by any DOB enforcement or rehabilitation activity to maximize the effectiveness and impact of DOB.

Duties And Responsibilities

Provides critical analysis and evaluations of actual or potential effectiveness of current and/or projected program activities related to DOB. Provides technical assistance in the design, development and implementation of improved program designs/operations for inspections, back-office analysis, or escalated enforcement support. Reviews and analyzes planning and operations activities of major program areas administered by the department, including residential inspections, vacant property inspections, other inspections, civil infractions, and other escalated enforcement.

Conducts management surveys, audits, projects, etc., and provides advisory services to operating or management officials including the Zoning Administrator. Based upon the assessments made, incumbent identifies actual or potential problem areas, trends, and/or areas of significant concerns within the strategic code enforcement and agency enforcement space. Develops, recommends and implements policies for corrective actions, necessary to remedy deficiencies in program areas to improve enforcement outcomes. Plans, develops and implements a system to collect and deliver data required for long-range planning, projections and operational evaluations, including developing and managing a comprehensive survey of the District’s built environment to support enforcement operations.

Qualifications And Education

Specialized experience is work that has equipped the applicant with the knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position. To be creditable, applicants must have at least one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression.

Incumbent must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license to drive a government vehicle to any place in the District for potential projects relating to specific properties.

The work is performed in an office setting.

Build and implement Generative AI solutions using large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic AI workflows where appropriate. Advanced SQL skills with experience querying complex relational databases and data warehouses. rows.descriptionText:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

RAD Business Systems Analyst

Your Impact at GEICO

At GEICO, our Research, Analytics and Development (RAD) team leverages data, technology, analytics, and AI-enabled automation to drive innovation and support strategic business decisions. As a Business Systems Analyst, you will serve in a critical role working closely with business leaders and engineering teams to refine business needs into scalable, data-driven solutions while identifying opportunities to use AI tools to automate business processes, improve reporting, and streamline requirements, testing, and delivery activities.

 

How You’ll Make a Difference

Customer Interaction

Partner with stakeholders and lead cross-functional communication Present updates clearly and build trusted relationships 

Needs Assessment

Gather, document, and refine business and system requirements Translate needs into user stories, workflows, and improvement opportunities Use AI tools to support requirements gathering, documentation, workflow analysis, and automation opportunities across business processes 

Problem Resolution

Analyze issues, test solutions, and identify opportunities to use AI to create test plans, automate test cases, and improve solution validation Support troubleshooting and validate fixes 

Meaningful Impact

Apply AI-enabled automation to improve business processes, data analysis, reporting, and operational efficiency Improve operations through data-driven solutions Promote data standards and Agile progress 

What We’re Looking For  

Experience & Qualifications: 

1–2 years of experience using AI tools to support business process automation, including requirements of documentation, workflow improvements, test planning, test case automation, data analysis, and reporting. Experience eliciting and documenting functional system requirements in partnership with project stakeholders. Experience developing test plans, creating and executing QA or automated test scripts, and validating system functionality through regression and scenario-based testing. 

Core Skills: 

Candidate must possess strong written and verbal communication skills, a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, a strong analytical ability, and a willingness to respond to ad hoc requests from customers in a timely manner. Must be able to work independently with limited supervision, perform under pressure, and multi-task. 

Preferred Skills: 

Candidate with or pursuing a degree in Information Systems, Computer Science or related field/equivalent experience is preferred. Prior experience in insurance and knowledge on insurance products Agile/SAFE certifications. Experience working in an Agile environment and familiarity with Agile project management practices. Experience with Software Development Life Cycle. Knowledge of Data Management concepts, including data modeling, architecture, and data governance. Working knowledge of SQL is preferred Coding experience and the utilization of AI in code generation for the purpose of creating user interfaces and business support logic. 

Annual Salary

$64,575.00 - $129,150.00

Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

At this time, GEICO will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

Johns Hopkins Technology Ventures (JHTV), the university's technology commercialization division, is launching the JHTV Analyst Program, a structured two-year experiential learning opportunity designed for recent graduates interested in innovation, entrepreneurship, healthcare, science, business, law, technology, and public impact.

We are seeking an Analyst, Ventures & Capital Strategy who will contribute to high-priority strategic initiatives while gaining broad exposure to technology commercialization, startup formation, intellectual property, corporate engagement, venture funding, and innovation management. Through cohort-based learning, professional development programming, executive exposure, cross-functional projects, and mentorship, analysts develop the analytical, communication, and leadership skills that prepare them for graduate study or future careers across the innovation economy.

At the end of the two-year term, Analysts may be considered for open positions within JHTV or the university; however, continuation of employment beyond the term is not guaranteed.

The Analyst, Ventures & Capital Strategy will support startup portfolio management, translational funding programs, investor engagement activities, and strategic analysis. Through these efforts, the analyst will gain hands-on exposure to the capital, resources, and commercialization processes that help move Johns Hopkins innovations toward the market. This role provides experience within startup portfolio management and the broader technology commercialization ecosystem.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to support strategic initiatives and organizational priorities.Collect, organize, analyze, and synthesize information from multiple sources to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and recommendations.Develop reports, dashboards, presentations, briefing materials, and executive summaries for operational and strategic decision-making.Support projects involving faculty, university leaders, external partners, and other stakeholders by conducting research, analysis, and developing recommendations.Translate complex information into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences.Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism.Support business process improvement initiatives and recommend enhancements to tools, systems, workflows, and reporting practices.Maintain accurate records, documentation, trackers, and project materials.Build productive relationships across JHTV and the broader university community.Present findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and leadership.Participate in cohort-based onboarding, professional development programming, mentorship opportunities, and cross-functional learning experiences.Contribute to a capstone project and final presentation addressing a strategic opportunity or challenge within JHTV.Support special projects and other duties as assigned.

In addition to duties described above

Conduct market, technical, competitive, and commercial research on emerging technologies.Prepare analyses and presentation materials for interactions with venture capital firms and other external partners.Support the management and analysis of a portfolio of more than 140 startup companies.Develop data-driven insights to inform commercialization strategy and funding decisions.Work closely with faculty innovators, investors, and commercialization professionals.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in a related field.No prior professional experience required.Additional education may substitute for required experience, and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.

Preferred Qualifications

U.S. Citizen or Legal Permanent Resident required due to Federal Export Controls.Advanced degree in a related field.Three years of related experience.Interest in venture capital, startups, or life sciences/technology commercialization.Strong quantitative and analytical skills.Comfort engaging with external partners and investors.Full-time, in-person role based in Baltimore, MD.Fast-paced environment with variable hours; not a fixed 9-to-5 schedule.

Technical Skills & Expected Level Of Proficiency

Data Management and Analysis - DevelopingBusiness Process Analysis - DevelopingReport Writing - DevelopingPresentations - DevelopingProject Management - DevelopingStakeholder Engagement - DevelopingChange Management - Developing

The core technical skills listed are most essential; additional technical skills may be required based on specific division or department needs.

rows.descriptionText:
Description 

Project: Large-Scale Logistics System Modernization

 Job Summary 

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Functional Specialist to support the modernization of a major logistics enterprise. The specialist will be a key member of a transformation and integration team, responsible for ensuring the successful implementation and adoption of a new Oracle SaaS-based logistics management system. This role focuses on aligning the system's out-of-the-box (OOTB) capabilities with business requirements, driving process re-engineering, and ensuring the solution meets the strategic objectives of the program. Oracle EBS and Oracle Fusion experience required.

 Key Responsibilities 

Business Process Analysis and Re-engineering:Analyze and document current ("As-Is") logistics and supply chain business processes within legacy systems.Conduct fit-gap analysis to compare business needs against the native capabilities of the Oracle SaaS solution, identifying areas for process improvement and minimizing technical customization.Design and develop optimized ("To-Be") business process maps and workflows that align with industry best practices and leverage standard Oracle SaaS functionality.Business Requirements Management:Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into clear, concise, and comprehensive functional requirements.Manage and govern the requirements lifecycle, ensuring all requirements are captured, tracked, and traced within a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM).Review inbound functional requirements and recommend changes to underlying business processes and/or policies to enable use of Oracle Fusion OOTB capabilities, challenging requests for customization and guiding stakeholders toward standard solutions.System and Solution Analysis:Act as a subject matter expert on the Oracle SaaS solution's logistics and supply chain modules.Provide functional support for testing activities, including facilitating User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that the solution meets business intent and complies with all relevant policies and requirements.Analyze and de-conflict organizational policies, directives, and procedures that may hinder the adoption of modern, industry-standard logistics processes.Data and Compliance:Support the implementation of a data governance and management plan to ensure the integrity, accuracy, and completeness of accountable property data within the new system.Assist in documenting and mapping key security, compliance, and auditability requirements to the system design.


 Qualifications 

 Additional Skills & Qualifications 

 Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Proven experience as an Oracle Functional Consultant or Specialist, with a strong focus on Oracle Cloud SaaS applications (e.g., Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM, ERP). Demonstrated experience in business process analysis, fit-gap analysis, and process re-engineering. Expertise in translating business needs into functional requirements and managing them throughout a project lifecycle. Familiarity with Agile or Lean-Agile project management methodologies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to advocate for standard solutions over customization. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. rows.title: ITAM Analyst (SAM/HAM)
rows.descriptionText:
Ideal Candidate Profile: Seeking an ITAM Analyst (SAM/HAM) with Flexara, Software & hardware asset management experience who supports Software Asset Management modernization by managing and improving software contract, entitlement, renewal, usage, ownership, compliance, and vendor data. This role supports software cost optimization, tool rationalization, governed intake, renewal readiness, audit preparation, vendor governance, SAM reporting, and CMDB alignment. The Analyst III helps ensure software assets are visible, governed, cost-effective, compliant, and aligned to enterprise technology standards. This role partners with ITAM, Procurement, Finance, Security, Legal, Workforce, Endpoint, Support Center, Product, application owners, and vendors to improve software lifecycle governance, reduce unmanaged renewals, support self-service software access, strengthen CMDB alignment, and improve leadership visibility through reliable reporting. The Analyst III is expected to analyze software data, identify trends and risks, recommend improvements, coordinate with stakeholders, support complex renewals and software reviews, and help improve SAM processes and controls. The role also requires curiosity and a commitment to keeping up with evolving technology, including SAM platforms, SaaS management tools, Flexera capabilities, automation, AI-enabled productivity tools, software metering, entitlement normalization, CMDB integration, and software governance best practices. In addition to its primary SAM focus, this role provides Hardware Asset Management (HAM) support at the Reston, VA office, including hardware moves, shipping/receiving coordination, inventory reviews, device recovery efforts, and related physical asset activities.

About The Opportunity

The ITAM Analyst Software Asset Management leads operational and analytical work across Client's software asset lifecycle. This role helps govern software inventory, license assignments, entitlements, renewals, usage, application ownership, contract records, vendor performance, compliance evidence, software intake, and lifecycle reporting. The analyst will help advance Software Asset Management modernization by improving data quality, entitlement accuracy, renewal tracking, license visibility, software utilization, compliance readiness, financial transparency, and operational consistency across the software lifecycle. This includes software intake, approval, procurement support, assignment, provisioning coordination, renewal, reclamation, retirement, compliance review, and vendor governance. This role partners closely with ITAM, Procurement, Finance, Security, Legal, Workforce, Endpoint, Support Center, Product, application owners, vendor partners, and other cross-functional teams to reduce software waste, improve service delivery, strengthen compliance, support reliable workforce operations, and provide leadership with trusted reporting. This position requires strong analytical thinking, communication, customer service, attention to detail, follow-through, cross-functional coordination, and the ability to work through complex software issues across multiple systems, teams, vendors, and governance processes. The ITAM Analyst III is expected to apply technology learning in practical ways by leading improvements that reduce manual work, improve software data accuracy, strengthen audit readiness, improve reporting, increase license reuse and reclamation, and enhance the employee software request and fulfillment experience. This role also supports HAM operations at the Reston, VA office, helping ensure hardware moves, shipping/receiving, inventory reviews, and device recovery activities run smoothly.

 Technology and Continuous Learning

The ITAM Analyst III Software Asset Management is expected to stay current with evolving workplace technology, software asset management practices, automation opportunities, and industry trends. This includes developing and applying knowledge of modern SAM platforms, SaaS management tools, license optimization methods, CMDB data practices, software discovery, software metering, AI-enabled productivity tools, reporting dashboards, vendor management capabilities, and compliance practices. The Analyst III should bring a learner's mindset and look for practical ways to apply new tools and technology improvements to reduce manual work, improve data accuracy, strengthen audit readiness, improve software utilization, and enhance the employee software request and fulfillment experience.

 Operational Requirement

Ability to support technology inventory reviews, software true-up activities, audit evidence preparation, vendor data validation, renewal reviews, software utilization analysis, and special projects.

Ability to support hardware-related activities where software entitlement, device assignment, or endpoint software deployment data is required.

Ability to participate in onsite meetings, vendor reviews, audits, operational activities, or cross-functional working sessions as needed.

Ability to manage multiple workstreams, prioritize effectively, and escalate risks or blockers before they impact delivery.

 Physical / Operational Requirement HAM Support

Ability to lift, carry, and move technology equipment weighing up to 50 lbs to support shipping and receiving of hardware.

Ability to support hardware moves, refresh activities, shipping and receiving coordination, inventory reviews, audits, device recovery efforts, and special projects.

Ability to provide off-hours support as needed for hardware moves, refreshes, audits, urgent asset activities, recovery escalations, or special projects.

Ability to participate in onsite meetings, vendor reviews, audits, and operational activities at the Reston, VA office as needed.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Manage and improve software asset management activities across the full software lifecycle, including intake, request, approval, procurement support, assignment, entitlement tracking, renewal, reclamation, retirement, and compliance review.

Maintain accurate software asset records, including licenses, entitlements, subscriptions, renewals, service agreements, contracts, warranties, vendor contacts, application owners, ownership fields, usage data, and lifecycle information.

Track and update software ownership, usage, assignment, entitlement, renewal status, contract terms, license type, and compliance status to improve visibility and governance.

Analyze software asset data to identify unused licenses, duplicate applications, renewal risks, data gaps, compliance issues, shadow IT indicators, and cost optimization opportunities.

Support software request and fulfillment processes by validating entitlement availability, approval status, licensing requirements, ownership, compliance restrictions, and provisioning readiness.

Perform software license reconciliation, usage review, exception reporting, audit evidence gathering, and SLA Health Check activities.

Generate and distribute software reports, compliance reports, renewal reports, usage reports, lifecycle status reports, vendor performance reports, and trend analyses to support decision-making across ITAM and Technology teams.

Identify software eligible for reclamation, reuse, renewal adjustment, retirement, consolidation, rationalization, or cost optimization.

Support vendor governance activities, including software catalog updates, renewal tracking, SLA review, billing accuracy reviews, contract validation, vendor performance reporting, and service performance reporting.

Collaborate with ITAM, Procurement, Finance, Security, Legal, Workforce, Endpoint, Support Center, Product, application owners, and vendor teams to resolve software asset issues and improve lifecycle processes.

Maintain and improve processes related to software asset management, software compliance, CMDB alignment, vendor governance, software intake, and audit readiness.

Identify process gaps and recommend improvements that reduce manual work, improve software data quality, increase automation, and strengthen license governance.

Support high-risk vendor and software title reviews by validating licensing compliance, renewal readiness, ownership, usage, security review status, and shadow IT exposure.

Keep up with emerging technology, SAM best practices, automation tools, AI-enabled solutions, SaaS management trends, CMDB practices, and software governance capabilities.

Contribute to knowledge base articles, process documentation, standard operating procedures, software request guides, reporting guides, and training materials.

Provide high-quality internal customer support when responding to software-related requests, incidents, escalations, and inquiries.

Provide support for software renewals, audits, true-ups, reclamation efforts, vendor reviews, reporting requests, and special projects as required.

Maintain and govern accurate hardware asset records for laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, and monitors - including warranties, service agreements, assignment details, ownership, location, and lifecycle status.

Support hardware moves, refresh activities, shipping and receiving coordination, inventory reviews, audits, device recovery efforts, and special projects at the Reston, VA office.

Provide off-hours support as needed for hardware moves, refreshes, audits, urgent asset activities, recovery escalations, or special projects.

 Software Asset Lifecycle Operations and Data Accuracy 30%

Maintain accurate software asset records across the full lifecycle, including intake, procurement support, approval, assignment, renewal, reclamation, retirement, and compliance review.

Track software ownership, application owner, vendor, license type, entitlement, subscription term, renewal date, usage status, contract status, and related software asset information.

Perform software asset reconciliation and resolve data discrepancies across systems, reports, tickets, vendor records, procurement files, contract records, CMDB records, and usage dashboards.

Analyze software asset data to identify trends, risks, gaps, unused licenses, duplicate tools, upcoming renewals, compliance issues, and opportunities for optimization.

Support software lifecycle stages, including request, approval, procurement support, provisioning coordination, license assignment, renewal, reclamation, retirement, and exception handling.

Execute and improve processes related to software asset management, software catalog accuracy, license compliance, renewal readiness, and lifecycle governance.

Support end users, managers, application owners, and support teams with software asset-related inquiries, ticket updates, entitlement questions, and escalation support.

Support special software programs, renewal activities, true-ups, audits, reclamation campaigns, application rationalization efforts, and other business priorities as needed.

 Software Licensing, Renewals, Compliance, and Optimization 30%

Track software licenses, subscriptions, entitlements, renewals, service agreements, contracts, maintenance terms, and vendor obligations.

Perform software license reconciliation, normalization, usage analysis, entitlement validation, and compliance review activities.

Monitor upcoming renewals and partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, Security, application owners, and vendors to support timely renewal decisions.

Identify underused, unused, duplicate, expired, over-provisioned, or non-compliant software assets and recommend corrective actions.

Support software reclamation efforts by identifying inactive users, validating license usage, coordinating removal or reassignment, and updating software records.

Support software request processes by confirming license availability, approval requirements, compliance restrictions, and assignment status.

Help maintain a software catalog that supports clear request paths, approved applications, ownership, licensing requirements, and renewal visibility.

Contribute to cost optimization by improving software utilization, reducing unnecessary renewals, and supporting consolidation or retirement of redundant applications.

 Audit, Compliance, Reporting, Vendor Governance, and CMDB Alignment 25%

Support software audit readiness through evidence gathering, license reconciliation, exception tracking, control validation, and reporting.

Perform SLA Health Checks and remediation follow-up for software asset control gaps, entitlement discrepancies, renewal risks, and compliance exceptions.

Generate recurring reports on software inventory, license utilization, renewal status, entitlement accuracy, vendor performance, billing accuracy, compliance status, and software exceptions.

Support vendor governance activities, including software catalog maintenance, contract review, renewal support, invoice validation, billing accuracy review, and vendor performance reporting.

Help ensure software asset data supports financial stewardship, risk management, audit readiness, vendor accountability, lifecycle planning, and operational decision-making.

Support CMDB alignment by improving data quality across employee, software entitlement, application ownership, vendor, lifecycle, contract, and access-relevant software records.

Monitor software asset trends to identify risks related to unmanaged applications, shadow IT, unused licenses, upcoming renewals, non-compliant software, and data quality gaps.

Partner with ITAM leadership and cross-functional teams to improve software governance, reporting accuracy, compliance confidence, and renewal planning.

 Process Improvement, Automation, Technology Learning, and Team Collaboration 15%

Provide meaningful contributions to team discussions related to software process improvement, operational strategy, technology adoption, asset governance, and future-state SAM modernization.

Identify opportunities to streamline software requests, approval, renewal, reclamation, reporting, compliance, and vendor governance workflows.

Support improvements to Jira, ITSM platforms, CMDB, reporting dashboards, software discovery tools, SaaS management tools, vendor reports, and future Software Asset Management platform capabilities.

Stay current with software asset management best practices, automation, AI-enabled tools, SaaS management trends, license optimization practices, CMDB practices, and emerging workplace technology.

Contribute ideas, documentation, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, and peer support that advance continuous improvement across SAM operations.

Communicate effectively, build strong relationships, and help resolve software asset issues collaboratively across ITAM, Procurement, Finance, Security, Legal, Workforce, Endpoint, Support Center, Product, application owners, and vendor teams.

Support cross-training peers and resolving software asset issues when first presented without escalation where possible.

Support a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, customer service, and operational excellence across Software Asset Management.

 Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Support Onsite Reston, VA

The following HAM support tasks are performed at the Reston, VA office alongside this role's core SAM responsibilities above. They do not carry a separate percentage allocation against the SAM responsibility totals (which remain 100% as defined); rather, this is supplemental scope tied to the role's onsite HAM presence.

Maintain and govern accurate hardware asset records for laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, and monitors, including warranties, service agreements, assignment details, ownership, location, and lifecycle status.

Support hardware moves, refresh activities, shipping and receiving coordination, inventory reviews, audits, device recovery efforts, and special projects.

Coordinate with Procurement, vendors, Endpoint, Support Center, Workforce, and ITAM teams for hardware receiving, assignment, shipping, return, storage, and disposal.

Provide off-hours support as needed for hardware moves, refreshes, audits, urgent asset activities, recovery escalations, or special projects.

Required Skills & Experience

Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience, in software asset management, technology operations, internal customer support, procurement, licensing, vendor management, or related fields, along with 5-7+ years of experience supporting software asset management, software licensing, SaaS administration, renewal coordination, entitlement tracking, procurement coordination, vendor coordination, or internal technology support.

Strong experience managing software records across the full asset lifecycle, including request, approval, procurement support, assignment, renewal, reclamation, retirement, and compliance review.

Experience tracking and maintaining accurate records for software licenses, subscriptions, entitlements, renewals, service agreements, contracts, application owners, vendors, users, and compliance status.

Ability to analyze software asset data, identify discrepancies, resolve entitlement gaps, document findings, recommend improvements, and follow through on corrective actions.

Experience supporting software request, renewal, reclamation, and compliance processes, including usage review, license reassignment, inactive user cleanup, and escalation of renewal or compliance risks.

Ability to work collaboratively and tactfully with vendors, suppliers, internal customers, managers, ITAM, Procurement, Finance, Security, Legal, Workforce, Endpoint, Support Center, Product, application owners, and other cross-functional partners.

Strong customer service, written communication, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to update tickets, prepare software asset reports, document processes, and explain license or entitlement information clearly.

Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning emerging software asset management practices, automation tools, AI-enabled solutions, CMDB practices, SaaS management platforms, software discovery tools, and industry best practices.

Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, follow established procedures, escalate risks or blockers appropriately, travel as needed, and contribute to continuous improvement across software asset management operations.

rows.title: Distillation Technician
rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Distillation Technician

Job Description

The Distillation Technician operates and oversees specialized equipment used in the distillation process to produce target compounds from specified raw materials. This role focuses on precise temperature control, accurate documentation in line with GMP and SOP requirements, and consistent data entry into internal tracking systems. The technician performs product inspections, supports quality control testing, and contributes to continuous process improvement within a manufacturing environment.

Responsibilities

Operate and monitor distillation equipment to process target compounds and batches from specified raw materials.Perform temperature checks throughout the distillation process and ensure all parameters remain within specified ranges.Complete batch records accurately and thoroughly in compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and standard operating procedures (SOPs).Carry out required calculations for product specifications and process parameters, ensuring accuracy and consistency.Conduct product inspections at appropriate process stages and prepare samples for quality control testing.Record all required process data points and maintain accurate documentation for each batch.Use computer systems to input and maintain data in internal tracking systems and production records.Handle, mix, and compound chemicals safely as part of batch making, purification, and blending processes.Follow best practices and established SOPs while actively contributing ideas to improve processes and efficiency.Work independently to manage assigned production tasks, including operating equipment and documenting all activities.Ensure careful handling of expensive ingredients and materials to minimize loss and maintain product quality.Collaborate with colleagues and interact effectively at various levels within the organization to support production goals.Adhere to all safety, quality, and compliance requirements in a manufacturing-type setting.Work the assigned 1:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. shift, Monday through Friday, and adjust to different shifts as required.

Essential Skills

Experience operating distillation equipment and performing distillation of target compounds from specified raw materials.Knowledge of distillation processes such as fractional distillation and steam distillation.Ability to perform accurate temperature checks and maintain process conditions within required limits.Experience completing batch records in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and standard operating procedures (SOPs).Strong attention to detail when recording process data and completing documentation.Ability to perform calculations related to product specifications and process parameters.Comfort using computer systems to input and manage data in internal tracking or production systems.Experience with chemical handling, mixing, compounding, blending, and batch making in a production or laboratory setting.Capability to work independently and manage tasks with minimal supervision.Ability to work the 1:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. shift, Monday through Friday, and flexibility to work different shifts as required.Minimum of a high school degree with a strong focus on accuracy and detail.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Previous experience in distillation operations is preferred.Previous experience working in a GMP-regulated environment is preferred.Experience in chemical operations, chemistry, or related manufacturing processes is beneficial.Experience in a production, manufacturing, or laboratory environment involving purification, compounding, and batch making is advantageous.Ability to learn unique and highly detailed processes quickly and apply them consistently.Strong communication skills and the ability to interact comfortably at various levels within the organization.Demonstrated ability to work with expensive ingredients and materials responsibly.

Work Environment

The role is based in a manufacturing-type setting where the Distillation Technician works largely independently while managing detailed calculations, product specifications, and documentation requirements. The environment emphasizes strong attention to detail, with frequent data entry into internal tracking systems and adherence to GMP and SOP standards. The culture reflects a family-owned, work-hard-play-hard atmosphere, with direct and straightforward communication and interaction across different levels of the organization. The typical dress code is casual, such as jeans and a t-shirt, while maintaining appropriate standards for a production environment. The primary shift runs from 1:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., Monday through Friday, with the possibility of working different shifts as needed.

Job Type & Location

This is a Contract to Hire position based out of Belcamp, MD.

Pay And Benefits

Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors.
