rows.title: Model Risk Manager (UK Bank)
rows.descriptionText:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We're looking for a Model Risk Manager who's passionate about data and analytics to apply ML/AI techniques across a variety of business areas for our UK Bank. You'll challenge existing modelling processes and elevate them to new standards, supporting growth and ensuring models drive business decisions, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What You’ll Be Doing

Contributing to providing key insights on material models to senior management and the BoardIdentifying areas for improvement in modelling processes and methodologies, ensuring models are within our risk appetiteSupporting the provision of recommendations to model developers to mitigate riskEmbedding and maintaining model risk management practices across the model lifecycleImproving the understanding of model assumptions, limitations, and outputs among senior management

What You'll Need

4+ years of experience validating and/or developing market risk, liquidity risk, capital risk, finance, treasury, financial crime, and/or data science modelsSolid working knowledge of Python and SQLExperience with probability distributions, time series analysis, regression modelling, and Monte Carlo simulationsExcellent communication skills and the capacity to work effectively under pressureThe ability to operate autonomously and engage confidently with stakeholders at all levels

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

 Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

rows.title: Senior Software Engineer - Machine Learning (Marketplace Dynamics) (Remote - United Kingdom)
rows.descriptionText:
Summary

Yelp engineering culture is driven by our values: we’re a cooperative team that values individual authenticity and encourages creative solutions to problems. All new engineers deploy working code their first week, and we strive to broaden individual impact with support from managers, mentors, and teams. At the end of the day, we’re all about helping our users, growing as engineers, and having fun in a collaborative environment.

Are you intrigued by data? Yelp has hundreds of millions of pieces of user-contributed content, millions of users and business listings, and hundreds of thousands of advertising customers – and all of these numbers are constantly growing. Making sense of this data, deducing relationships between variables, and figuring out different interactions is hard work, but these insights are hugely impactful to Yelp’s business.

At Yelp’s Lead Optimization team, we are passionate about connecting users with the service professional that matches their needs. Whether you’re looking for a plumber, contractor, or an electrician, we believe that better matching and accurate pricing in Yelp’s Service marketplace results in higher engagement from business owners and users, who are a critical part of what allows Yelp’s business model to thrive.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, self-driven machine learning scientist who will help invent the future of optimization at Yelp. In this role, you’ll hone your skills in ML techniques like GBDT, ensemble models, and embeddings while building scalable industrial systems. As a member of a collaborative team of talented software and ML engineers, you’ll have a unique opportunity to drive massive impact for users, businesses and Yelp.

This opportunity requires you to be located in the United Kingdom. We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes.

What You'll Do

Identify and own challenging problems, form testable hypotheses, and drive significant business impactLead the design and analysis of experiments or development of causal and predictive models to test your ideasCollaborate with product and engineering to affect changes in production systems and provide intelligence to other teams and communicate your conclusions to technical and non-technical audiences alikeKeep the team and our projects current on new developments in ML and statistics by reading papers and attending conferences and local eventsProductionize and automate model pipelines within Python services

What It Takes To Succeed

Experience with data analysis/statistical software and packages (pandas/statsmodels/sklearn within Python, R, etc.)Experience with predictive modeling/machine learning, forecasting, or causal inferenceComfortable working in a Unix environmentSufficient software engineering skills to effectively work with software engineers.A demonstrated capability for original research, the curiosity to uncover promising solutions to new problems, and the persistence to carry your ideas through to an end goalThe motivation to develop deep product and business knowledge and to connect abstract modeling and analysis tasks with business value

What You'll Get

Full responsibility for projects from day one, a collaborative team, and a dynamic work environment.Competitive salary, a pension scheme, and an optional employee stock purchase plan.25 days paid holiday (rising to 29 with service), plus one floating holiday.£150 monthly reimbursement to help cover remote working expenses.£75 caregiver reimbursement to support dependent care for families.Private health insurance, including dental and vision.Flexible working hours and meeting-free Wednesdays.Regular 3-day Hackathons, bi-weekly learning groups, and productivity spending to support and encourage your career growth. Opportunities to participate in digital events and conferences.£75 per month to use toward qualifying wellness expenses.Quarterly team offsites.

Closing

Yelp values diversity. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition, disability, or any other protected status.

Notice to Northern Ireland Applicants

A Basic criminal background check via AccessNI is required for employment. Yelp complies with the AccessNI Code of Practice. Having a criminal record will not necessarily prevent a candidate from working with Yelp. Yelp will consider the nature of the position together with the circumstances and background of the candidate's offences or other information contained on a disclosure certificate. AccessNI's Privacy Policy is available here. Yelp's Criminal Background Check Policy is available upon request. 

Note: Yelp does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to any recruiting alias or employee. Yelp is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Recruiting and Applicant Privacy Notice

rows.title: Senior Analyst, Technology & Data Assurance
rows.descriptionText:
The Risk Assurance & Insight function supports Baillie Gifford’s Investment Risk, Compliance, Business Risk and Anti-Financial Crime functions through second-line monitoring, assurance, risk oversight, reporting, training coordination and operational support activities.
The Risk and Compliance Assurance team provides independent check and challenge across key regulatory, compliance, operational, investment and financial crime risk areas. The team assesses whether controls are designed and operating effectively, identifies areas for improvement and supports the business in maintaining effective risk management arrangements.
Data, management information and technology are used to improve the quality, consistency, coverage and efficiency of monitoring, assurance and reporting activity.
Purpose of roleThe Senior Analyst, Technology & Data Assurance will manage and strengthen the technology, data and automation capability that underpins the firm’s second-line Risk and Compliance Assurance programme. The role will also perform risk-based monitoring and assurance activity, including surveillance case review, control testing, analysis of system outputs and the identification of trends, anomalies and potential control issues.
The role will act as a bridge between assurance professionals, Technology, data teams and system owners, helping to turn assurance requirements into scalable monitoring, surveillance and analytical solutions. It will support the effective use of trade surveillance, e-communications monitoring, data platforms, automation and AI-enabled tools across assurance activity. A key focus will be the day-to-day management and use of trade surveillance and e-communications systems, including system tuning and configuration, alert and case review, analysis of system performance and escalation of matters requiring further review.
This is not a software development role. The role requires experience managing or using compliance surveillance systems, sufficient technical capability to understand systems, data, workflows and controls, and a practical understanding of assurance needs and risk-based testing. The role holder will help confirm that technology supports effective assurance coverage, consistent control testing and clear insight, while retaining appropriate professional judgement and challenge.
Responsibilities
Support the day-to-day management, configuration and effective use of compliance surveillance systems, including trade surveillance and e-communications monitoring. This includes rules, parameters, workflows, user access, alert quality and oversight of system outputs.Perform risk-based monitoring and assurance work across Investment Risk, Compliance, Business Risk and Anti-Financial Crime, supporting technology-enabled approaches where these improve coverage, consistency and efficiency.Review alerts and cases, analyse system outputs and assess whether issues require escalation, further review or wider assurance activity.Use data, management information and AI-enabled tools to identify trends, anomalies, exceptions, potential control issues and emerging risks, and to improve the targeting of monitoring and assurance work.Work with assurance colleagues to translate monitoring and testing requirements into repeatable data queries, dashboards, automated workflows and analytical routines.Support data quality, lineage, access and reconciliation activity where these affect the reliability of monitoring or assurance outputs, working with Technology, data owners and system owners to resolve issues.Contribute to the design and implementation of continuous monitoring capability, including automated exception identification, risk indicators and repeatable review processes.Assess, test and validate new monitoring, surveillance, automation and AI capabilities before implementation, balancing efficiency and innovation with control, evidential quality and appropriate human oversight.Produce clear management information on system performance, alert volumes, data quality, trends, exceptions, escalations and assurance outcomes for senior colleagues and relevant stakeholders.Help develop standards, documentation and repeatable practices that allow the wider Risk Assurance & Insight team to use surveillance systems, data, technology and AI confidently and consistently.
Your knowledge and experienceExperience using technology, data or automation to support and deliver risk-based monitoring, assurance, oversight, audit or control activity, preferably in financial services or asset management.Experience performing risk-based monitoring activity, including reviewing alerts and cases, analysing system outputs, identifying potential issues and documenting clear conclusions.Experience managing compliance surveillance systems, including trade surveillance, e-communications monitoring, workflow, reporting or other oversight platforms.Confidence working with system configuration, rules, parameters, workflows, user access, testing, issue resolution and oversight of system outputs.Strong data literacy, with the ability to analyse alerts, cases, system outputs and management information to identify trends, anomalies, exceptions and potential control issues.Practical understanding of risk and control concepts, including how technology can support evidence-based assurance, control testing and alert-based review.Experience using automation, AI-enabled tools, analytics or low-code/no-code solutions to improve monitoring, assurance or reporting activity.Understanding of responsible AI use, including the need for human judgement, validation, data protection, clear records and appropriate challenge of outputs.Ability to work effectively with assurance specialists, Technology, data owners and system vendors, translating between business, assurance and technical requirements.Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues, limitations, assurance findings and opportunities clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
The type of candidate that we're looking forYou will be a practical systems, technology and data professional who is comfortable managing compliance surveillance systems and operating in a second-line risk and assurance environment. You will understand how trade surveillance, e-communications monitoring and related oversight systems support risk-based monitoring and assurance activity. You will be able to perform assurance work. This includes reviewing process and control, alerts and cases, analysing system outputs and evidence, identifying trends, anomalies and potential control issues, and documenting clear conclusions. You will be curious and improvement-focused, but disciplined about controls, evidence and accuracy. You will be able to challenge technology and AI outputs rather than accept them at face value. You will understand that AI and automation support professional judgement rather than replace it.
This is not a software development role. It is suited to someone with experience managing or using compliance surveillance systems, working with Technology and data owners, and helping assurance teams make effective use of data, technology and AI.
Critical SkillsData literacyDigital effectivenessImprovement mindsetOpenness and discernmentTeam working
Closing DateSeptember 26, 2026
Should you choose to use AI tools to support your application, we ask that you do this thoughtfully. We encourage you to ensure your application reflects your own voice, experience, and motivations. We value authenticity and want to understand your individual strengths and perspectives.
At Baillie Gifford, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful culture in which each of our colleagues can thrive and develop. We believe that our clients are best served by a diverse workforce with the experiences, ideas and perspectives that this brings.
If you are currently working at Baillie Gifford as an employee or contractor please apply to this job from the firm's Workday internal career site.

rows.title: 2027 Technology Developer Summer Internship Programme Glasgow
rows.descriptionText:
Explore the world of Barclays as a Summer Intern

Spend 10 weeks diving into real projects, gaining hands-on experience, and shaping your future. You’ll receive full support, take on meaningful responsibilities, and build lasting connections—all while discovering what makes our culture unique.

If you're in your penultimate year and ready to grow, learn, and make an impact, this is your opportunity to belong and thrive.

Our Expert Programme

You'll join our expert programme, a 1 year targeted, fast-track programme designed to give you depth and breadth of experience. Participating in job-based bespoke training from the start enabling you to go fully-equipped into your role as you develop specialist technical expertise.

Why the Technology Developer programme?

As a Developer, you’ll help design, build, test and maintain systems used across Barclays. This is more than writing code; you’ll play a role in solving complex problems for clients and customers. You may work with technologies including Java, C++, C#, Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, containers, DevOps, cloud, machine learning, scripting and real-time systems.

To be considered for this opportunity, you must be in your penultimate year of university. You must be graduating in 2028.

You’ll also bring a genuine interest in technology, strong problem-solving skills and the drive to deliver innovative solutions.

The location for this role is indicated in the job title, and you will be based at that location. If you are successful in receiving a return offer to our graduate programme, your location will be the same as it was during your internship.

Barclays will accept applications from candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the UK and will provide a skilled worker visa for successful applicants if they meet the Home Office’s eligibility criteria for a skilled worker visa.

Successful applicants who are not eligible to receive a skilled worker visa, and who we are therefore unable to secure a skilled worker visa for, will be required to have their own legal right to work in the UK on a full-time basis from June 2027 to August 2027.

Working In Glasgow

Our brand new state-of-the-art campus in Glasgow is somewhere you'll want to work. It's the home of a team of colleagues who thrive in an environment designed with collaboration and the future of work in mind. The campus is made up of creative spaces and technology with hybrid working opportunities at the heart.

As well as offering the perfect space for collaborative working, there's also plenty to get involved in outside of your day job, from live music in the canteen to colleague clubs and events.

It is the policy of Barclays to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.

The closing date for applications is 25 September 2026. Please note that this vacancy may close ahead of the advertised date due to application volumes, and we therefore recommend submitting your application as early as possible.

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

Accountabilities


Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.Collaboration with peers, participation in code reviews, and promotion of a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.


Analyst Expectations


To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertiseThorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertiseThey lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.Partner with other functions and business areas.Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

The security organization at Uber is dedicated to enabling safe and secure innovation while protecting the communities we serve both online and in the physical world. Our teams are responsible for protecting both people and their data across intersections of the digital and physical world. The primary objective for the Uber Engineering Security team is to enable the technical ambitions of the company while maintaining the highest standards of security and privacy for our customers and partners. As cybersecurity threats evolve, so do we.

We are seeking a Staff Security Engineer to join our Network Security team. In this role, you will define and build systems that improve bot detection and mitigation, and DDoS protection at a global scale. You will architect, build, and scale Uber's next-generation edge security infrastructure to safeguard our systems from volumetric attacks and evolving automated threats.  Architect, implement, and scale high-performance, distributed backend systems for real-time bot detection and mitigation, and volumetric DDoS defense. Evaluate, integrate, and partner with third-party vendor platforms to enhance threat detection coverage and deploy challenge capabilities.  Build end-to-end data pipelines and low-latency feature stores supporting both real-time network enforcement and batch threat intelligence.  Establish engineering standards, conduct system architecture reviews, and technically mentor junior engineers within the Network Security team. Experience with cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, GCP, OCI) and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Direct experience in network security, cybersecurity, bot detection, or DDoS mitigation at scale.  Experience evaluating, integrating, and managing third-party vendor solutions for bot challenge techniques and edge threat mitigation.  Hands-on experience incorporating AI/ML models into production systems and working with real-time streaming frameworks (e.g., Apache Flink, Kafka).  Proven track record of leading complex, multi-team software initiatives from inception to delivery.

Overview

Job Description:

Chewy is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our Finance team supporting the dynamic and fast-moving Marketing organization to drive revenue and customer growth for the company by partnering with the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) team.

This role supports strategic marketing efforts aimed at driving core enterprise growth and expansion priorities, supporting a diverse set of stakeholders across the CRM team. The CRM team owns campaigns and offers for retention and acquisition programs, tech platforms for personalization initiatives, as well as email, push notification, and direct mail operations. The person in this role will create financial and customer growth forecasts for key marketing activities and own financial planning and reporting cadences, controllership, rhythm of business, as well as improvement of our reporting and analysis infrastructure. The role directly supports several Sr. Director/Director partners and delivers insights and reporting to manage marketing investments and campaign performance across a wide portfolio of activity. The role also partners closely with Marketing FP&A to generate insightful business commentary for Finance and Marketing stakeholders. It supports efficiency in the organization by improving reporting infrastructure, driving automation, and driving analysis that improves performance.

This is a job for someone who can get close to the details, deeply understands financial modeling and reporting, partners well with business unit leaders, and is able to connect project work to the larger business strategy. To be successful in this role, the ideal candidate must be able to earn trust across their finance peers and business partners. The candidate will be organized, detail-oriented, and able to invent and improve processes. They will be an owner, raising their hand to investigate risks/opportunities, especially when ownership is ambiguous or unclear, as is often the case with new programs. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and financial modeling skills in a big data environment, and a drive to understand and inspect the granular operational metrics of the organization.

Bonus

MBA or advanced business degreeProficiency with SQL, Tableau, and HyperionFamiliarity with digital advertising & media channels, brand and creative operations, e-commerce, or other retail business models

rows.descriptionText:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Associate of Site Merchandising will own the end-to-end digital merchandising strategy and execution across our digital properties for a category or area of ownership. You will define how customers discover, browse, and shop across our digital channels – ensuring a seamless, inspiring, and high-converting experience that reflects both brand storytelling and business priorities.

This role sits at the intersection of art and analytics: part strategist, part operator, and part storyteller. You’ll partner closely with Merchandising, Marketing, and Creative teams to drive engagement, conversion, and revenue growth. You will lead the content strategy to improve discovery and inspire customers.

The Associate will put the customer at the center of all decisions by working closely with peers and cross-functional teams across business areas to create a seamless experience. The Associate demonstrates a deep understanding of business objectives, defining and implementing site strategies to meet business objectives. The Associate thrives on results, takes the initiative to advocate for business needs to support area of ownership, and reacts to business as needed. They must be highly analytical with strong business acumen, organized, and possess great communication and presentation skills as they will represent their category in many forums.

Collaboration: Collaborate with merchant teams to understand business strategy, objectives, and priorities.

Presentation Skills: Prepare and present quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to optimize taxonomy and search strategies, including competitive deep dives. Provide insights and strategies for the best online experience.

Cross-Functional Relationship Building: Foster strategic relationships with merchants, marketing, creative production, production, and internal site merchandise partners to leverage resources and establish best-in-class event execution.

Innovation and Competitive Analysis: Seek opportunities to grow the business by improving the customer shopping experience through innovation and competitive analysis.

Data Analysis: Work with business intelligence, experimentation, and relevancy teams to understand and develop comprehensive strategies for site audits.

Project Management: Ability to juggle multiple projects, identify primary and secondary objectives, prioritize time, and communicate timelines to team members.

Product/Project Ownership: Ability and desire to take ownership of products and projects.

Creative and Strategic Thinking: Ability to think creatively, strategically, and technically.

Technical Proficiency: Knowledge of MS Office computer programs is required.

Bachelor's Degree from 4-year college or university preferred3-5 years direct experienceStrong analytical skills, with ability to draw insights and conclusions from dataSelf-starter with strong sense of ownership and initiativeStrong problem-solving skills, balancing strategic thinking, technical knowledge, and creativityAbility to effectively share and communicate technical information to all levels of businessAbility to juggle multiple projects - can identify primary and secondary objectives, prioritize time and communicate timeline to team membersExcellent interpersonal skills, fostering effective collaboration and teamwork. Considered a true team playerKnowledge of MS Office computer programs is requiredAbility to work a flexible schedule based on department and Company needs

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Merchandise discountsPerformance-based incentivesAnnual merit reviewEmployee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial adviceTuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today!

This role is part of eBay’s Buying Conversion team and will lead the Shopping Intent portfolio of CRM experiences. You will serve as the portfolio lead for strategy, roadmap, execution, experimentation, and business impact. Your focus will be on customer-facing communications that help buyers reconnect with appropriate inventory. You will also support their progress along the purchase journey.

Shopping Intent sits at the center of eBay’s buyer re-engagement strategy. The portfolio activates both expressed and observed buyer intent signals — including saved searches, followed sellers, watched items, recently viewed items, carts, checkout, price changes, and other high-intent shopping behaviors — across email, push notifications, in-app notifications, and emerging CRM channels.

In this highly visible role, you will shape how eBay uses user intent, personalization, recommendation signals, and AI-powered decisioning to deliver more relevant, timely, and valuable customer communications while reducing fatigue and improving long-term customer value. You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, CRM, Data Science, and partner product teams across the customer experience to evolve the portfolio into a more intelligent, customer-centric re-engagement system.

If you are passionate about marketplace dynamics, customer-centric growth, and lifecycle communications, consider this outstanding opportunity. It involves building systems that turn buyer intent into relevant action. You will shape how eBay’s owned-channel conversion experiences change.

Job Description

About the Team

You will be part of a collaborative team responsible for creating assortment strategies based on analyzing sales and trend. Our job blends creativity, analytics, and marketing.

About The Role

You will report to a Buyer and share ownership of a category. You will assist in daily/seasonal tasks to help drive the business. As the Assistant Buyer, you will be responsible for maintaining data integrity, supporting the Buyer on seasonal needs, and working closely with multiple cross-functional teams. In this role you will have the opportunity to work in a fast-paced retail environment while working with a highly collaborative team.

This role requires being onsite in our San Francisco office Monday through Thursday, and remote option on Friday.

Responsibilities


 Work within Merchandise systems to set up and maintain all SKUs  Responsible for visual line and merchandise list  Communicate project and sample status updates, costing/SKU worksheets; responsible for passing new SKUs for placement once approved and tracking to PO due dates  Responsible for assisting sample management – communicating and partnering with our photo and warehouse teams to track sample positions  Prepare reporting as directed and assist the Buyer with business opportunities  Partner with the Buyer and Visual teams to plan seasonal retail floor sets, including assisting with seasonal walkthrough setups and updating relevant file  Maintain strong, positive relationships with cross-functional partners across inventory, design, development, e-commerce, and creative teams  Enter and maintain all regular pricing for DTC and Retail, working closely with inventory partners and sourcing teams  Manage personalization techniques, opportunities, and execution for photography and site  Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the relevant retail markets; maintain and upkeep competitive analyses 


Criteria


 BA /BS degree required  1-2 years of retail buying experience  Strong knowledge of retail math calculations  Ability to handle multiple priorities, shifting tasks and timelines  Ability to work autonomously, strong decision making skills with good judgement  Detail-oriented – takes the appropriate time to complete tasks and reviews work to ensure accuracy  Familiar and comfortable with pulling sales reports and strong ability to analyze business metrics  Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel/Word/PowerPoint); ability to create pivot tables and experience with advanced formulas such as VLOOKUP  Note: Occasional travel may be required within the bay area for photo shoots and floor sets. 


Our Culture & Values 

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First 

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands  A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities  Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer  Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits  Tax-free commuter benefits  A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health 


Continued Learning


 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University  Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities  Resources for self-development  Advisor (Mentor) program  Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series 


 WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration). 

 This role is not eligible for relocation assistance. 

 Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances. 

 The expected starting pay range for this position is $65,000-70,000. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities. 

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

Description & Requirements

The Bloomberg Structured Products team is responsible for all data, cash flows and analytics for the two million plus bonds that comprise the structured products universe. We own some of Bloomberg’s largest databases, highest hit services, most comprehensive cash flow model libraries, and most complex analytic tools and valuation screens. Our products support Bloomberg’s industry leading fixed income indices, security valuation services, portfolio management and trading platforms, as well as the daily workflow of countless traders, portfolio managers and research analysts.

Who We Are

The Bloomberg Structured Products Quantitative Research Team

We are an enthusiastic, talented team of quants who work side by side with product managers, engineers, and sales to create high impact valuation, surveillance and risk management tools for both internal and external clients.

Our teams develop models that forecast cash flows for a variety of Agency, Non-Agency and ABS securities, produce valuation metrics used to determine relative value, and develop risk analytics used to quantify market risk for hedging and return attribution.

We strive to create best-in-class prepayment/credit models for the US Agency MBS/CMBS, US Residential Non-Agency, Credit Risk Transfer (CRT), Mortgage Insurance, HELOC/HEL, Auto ABS and Japanese MBS markets. We also develop the home price and interest rate models that help power our prepayment and credit models. Our models are developed in conjunction with a comprehensive suite of daily analytics reports, model surveillance reports, whitepapers, specified pool cohorts, and valuation tools.

We aim to provide timely model updates that incorporate the latest prepayment and credit data, stay in sync with evolving market developments and expand model coverage for new product types, while allowing clients the ability to fully customize their user experience with a comprehensive and intuitive set of model overrides.

We strive to continually improve our valuation and surveillance platform by maintaining an ongoing, open dialogue with the entire community of traders, portfolio managers, regulators, research analysts and mortgage agencies that incorporate our models into their daily workflow as well as internal partners such as Index/PORT, BVAL, MARS, NEWS and BI.

Our current Agency MBS projects include the development of a loan-level agency prepayment model and a new prepayment model for the GNMA project loan sector.

Our current residential credit projects include the development of a new prepay/credit model for securities backed by home equity lines of credit (HELOC) and home equity loans (HEL), and expanding multipath OAS coverage for existing sectors through BTM model service enhancements.

Other projects include updates to our mortgage rate models and the development of a new home price model.

Who You Are

An innovative quantitative research analyst with a strong interest in financial markets. Someone who cares about the impact of their work and enjoys working with large datasets, conducting regression analysis, building analytic valuation tools, and supporting our clients. You enjoy collaborating and working closely with other people. You’re a problem solver, eager to learn, and have a strong interest in the structured products domain.

Work collaboratively with team members to manage and enhance the implementation of Bloomberg’s RFR market model for use in valuing US mortgage-backed securities Work collaboratively with team members to develop and release tools for conducting return attribution, total/excess return analysis, interest rate/volatility scenario analysis, per path OAS analysis, and risk measurement/risk management of US mortgage-backed securities Create analytical tools and reports that help clients track model performance, quantify market risk, and assess relative valueContribute to whitepapers, published reports, and webinars Help the team evolve and operate on a day-to-day basis

Description & Requirements

Our team:

The Market Specialist team within Financial Solutions serves as Bloomberg’s market, industry and workflow experts. Comprised of former traders, portfolio managers, analysts, sales professionals and industry practitioners, the team combines deep market expertise with an understanding of client workflows and Bloomberg’s product, data and technology solutions.

This is a highly client-facing and commercially focused role, working closely with Sales, Product, Data and Research teams to identify market opportunities, deepen client engagement, drive product adoption and support revenue growth.

What’s the role?

We are looking for a Metals & Commodities Market Specialist with deep knowledge of metals markets and a broader understanding of the global commodities landscape.

You will bring market expertise and industry perspective to conversations with trading desks, investors, financial institutions and corporations, helping clients navigate changing commodity markets and translate those challenges into Bloomberg workflows and solutions.

The role will cover the intersection of metals markets, trading, investment and the corporate value chain, including the market forces reshaping supply, demand, pricing, capital allocation and risk. You will engage with senior decision-makers, support strategic sales opportunities, identify emerging client needs and provide actionable feedback to Bloomberg's Product teams.

As client workflows increasingly incorporate AI, you will also help clients explore how generative AI, prompt engineering and agentic workflows can transform commodity research and analysis—combining market expertise with Bloomberg data and technology to make complex workflows more intuitive, scalable and actionable.

You will represent Bloomberg externally through client engagements, industry events, webinars, professional associations and thought leadership, building an active network across the commodities community and strengthening Bloomberg’s position as a partner to market participants.

We’ll Trust You To

 Serve as a subject matter expert on metals and commodity markets, bringing a strong understanding of market structure, pricing, supply and demand dynamics, trading and investment workflows. Partner with Sales leadership to identify addressable markets, strategic accounts and commercial opportunities across traders, financial institutions, commodity trading desks and corporations. Use your market expertise and understanding of client workflows to support revenue growth across the Bloomberg Terminal, Enterprise Data and broader Bloomberg solutions. Consult with senior decision-makers and market participants, understanding their investment, trading, research and risk challenges and demonstrating how Bloomberg data, analytics and technology can address them. Champion AI-enabled commodity workflows, helping clients use generative AI, prompt engineering and emerging agentic capabilities to accelerate research, interrogate data, identify market signals and improve decision-making. Translate deep commodity market expertise into effective prompts and AI workflows, understanding how context, data and domain expertise can improve the quality and relevance of AI-generated insights. Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for the metals and commodities business aligned with Sales, Product and broader firm priorities, establishing clear measures of commercial and client impact. Develop relationships with industry associations, exchanges, professional organizations, research communities and other market influencers to stay close to emerging trends and strengthen Bloomberg’s connectivity to the commodities ecosystem. Represent Bloomberg at industry conferences, client forums, webinars, roundtables and third-party events, contributing market insight, moderating conversations and developing thought leadership that strengthens Bloomberg’s external presence. Develop scalable client content, demonstrations, campaigns and internal training that strengthen the commodities capabilities of Bloomberg’s broader Sales organization. Collaborate across commodities specialties, identifying opportunities where metals intersect with energy, power, agriculture, environmental commodities and broader macro markets.

You’ll Need To Have

 Significant professional experience in metals and commodities markets, gained within financial services, trading, investment management, research, banking, mining, commodity-intensive corporates or a related industry. Deep knowledge of metals markets and the factors influencing pricing, supply, demand, trade flows and investment decisions. Strong understanding of relevant client workflows, which may include trading, analyst research, portfolio management, hedging, risk management, corporate finance, strategy or market analysis. A commercial mindset and demonstrated ability to translate market expertise into client engagement and business opportunities. Strong consultative skills with the ability to uncover client needs, handle objections and influence senior stakeholders. Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to make complex market concepts, analytics and workflows accessible to audiences with different levels of expertise. Strong business judgment and the ability to identify market trends and opportunities that can tangibly contribute to Bloomberg's commercial success. Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, Data and Research teams and influence outcomes in a highly collaborative environment. Experience with Bloomberg Professional Services or comparable financial market data, analytics and technology platforms. Willingness to travel across North America to engage with clients and industry participants.

Direct experience in base metals, precious metals, ferrous metals, mining or commodity trading. Experience working with both financial market participants and corporations, with an understanding of how commodity markets connect physical and financial workflows. Understanding of financial modeling, valuation and company analysis within the mining, materials or commodity sectors. An established external network across metals, mining, trading, investment, corporate markets, industry associations or other relevant commodity communities. Familiarity with derivatives, hedging and commodity risk-management workflows. Strong analytical skills and an ability to work across market, fundamental, company and alternative datasets. Experience using APIs, Excel, Python, Jupyter notebooks or other analytical tools to build and enhance market workflows. Experience experimenting with generative AI, prompt engineering or agentic workflows, particularly where these technologies can enhance research, analytics and decision-making. Intellectual curiosity around the structural forces reshaping commodities, including infrastructure investment, electrification, AI and power demand, supply-chain resilience and changing global trade patterns. Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

Johnson & Johnson MedTech is recruiting for a Senior Supply Chain Planning Analyst located in Irvine, CA.

The Senior Supply Chain Planning Analyst will play a key role in supporting the U.S.& Canada business through demand planning, forecasting, inventory management, and integrated business planning (IBP) activities for the assigned product portfolio.

This role will serve as a senior demand planning subject matter expert, responsible for developing and maintaining an accurate demand forecast by integrating historical trends, commercial insights, market intelligence, new product introductions, and business assumptions.

The Senior Supply Chain Planning Analyst will partner closely with Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Supply Planning, Global Planning, and other cross-functional stakeholders to identify risks and opportunities, develop planning scenarios, and translate business intelligence into actionable demand and inventory plans.The role is accountable for supporting key supply chain performance indicators including forecast accuracy, forecast bias, inventory levels, Weeks of Supply (WOS), Slow Moving and Obsolete inventory (SLOB), product availability, and customer service performance.

Key Responsibilities

Demand Planning & Forecasting & Inventory Management

Own and maintain the demand forecast for the assigned U.S. & Canada product portfolio across appropriate short-, medium-, and long-term planning horizons.Develop a statistically and commercially informed forecast using historical demand, sales trends, market intelligence, customer dynamics, promotional activity, new product introductions, product lifecycle assumptions, and commercial inputs.Lead the monthly demand planning cycle for the assigned portfolio, ensuring assumptions, risks, opportunities, and forecast changes are clearly documented and communicated.Analyze forecast performance using metrics including MAPE, forecast accuracy, forecast bias, and forecast value-add, and identify root causes of forecast error.Identify demand trends, changes in customer behavior, unusual consumption patterns, and emerging risks or opportunities requiring forecast adjustment.Challenge commercial assumptions and historical trends when appropriate to develop an objective, data-driven consensus demand plan.Facilitate cross-functional demand review discussions with Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and other business partners.Reconcile and explain differences between the demand plan, operational plan, and financial plan.Develop demand scenarios and sensitivity analyses to support business decisions and communicate potential upside and downside risks.Support development and execution of inventory strategies for the assigned portfolio, balancing customer service requirements, business growth, supply constraints, and working capital objectives.Monitor inventory performance including gross and net inventory dollars, Days of Supply, safety stock, excess inventory, Slow Moving and Obsolete inventory (SLOB), and inventory at risk.Recommend appropriate inventory targets and planning parameters based on demand variability, lead times, service requirements, lifecycle stage, and supply risk.Support establishment and periodic review of safety stock levels and inventory policies.Identify excess, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory risks and partner with cross-functional teams to develop mitigation and inventory reduction actions.Proactively identify potential inventory shortages or service risks and recommend corrective actions.Evaluate the inventory impact of forecast changes, new product introductions, discontinuations, supply constraints, and commercial initiatives.

Integrated Business Planning / S&OP

Play a key role in the U.S. & Canada Demand IBP process by preparing demand analyses, forecast recommendations, risks, opportunities, and scenarios for business review.Provide clear analytical insights and recommendations to support management decision-making during IBP and planning reviews.Support alignment between demand, supply, inventory, commercial, and financial plans.Identify significant gaps between forecast, sales, inventory, operational, and financial expectations and work cross-functionally to resolve them.Translate complex planning data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.

New Product & Lifecycle Planning

Support demand and inventory planning for new product introductions, product transitions, phase-outs, and discontinuations.Develop initial demand assumptions and forecast scenarios for new products in partnership with Marketing, Commercial, Finance, and Global Planning.Monitor actual launch performance against assumptions and rapidly adjust forecasts and inventory plans as new information becomes available.Develop inventory transition strategies to minimize excess and obsolete inventory during product lifecycle changes.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

Create and utilize advanced analytical tools and reporting to support forecasting, inventory optimization, issue resolution, and business decision-making.Conduct root-cause analyses of forecast error, inventory deviations, service issues, and other planning performance gaps.Identify and implement improvements to demand planning, forecasting, inventory management, IBP processes, planning parameters, and analytical capabilities.Leverage planning systems, ERP data, Excel, and analytical tools to improve planning accuracy, efficiency, and visibility.Support automation and standardization of recurring planning analyses and reporting.Provide senior-level planning expertise and guidance to other analysts and cross-functional partners.

Qualifications

Education:

A minimum of a Bachelor's degree is required. A Master's degree, MBA, APICS certification, or IBF certification is preferred.

Experience & Skills – Required

Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in supply chain planning, demand planning, forecasting, inventory planning, supply planning, S&OP/IBP, or related functions.Strong hands-on experience in demand planning and forecasting.Demonstrated ability to develop, analyze, and improve demand forecasts for complex product portfolios.Strong understanding of forecast accuracy measurements including MAPE and forecast bias.Experience managing or analyzing inventory including Days of Supply, safety stock, excess inventory, and SLOB.Experience conducting demand, inventory, and business scenario analyses.Strong understanding of integrated business planning / S&OP processes and the relationship between demand, supply, inventory, and financial plans.Strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain interactions and planning interdependencies.Strong understanding of planning system functionality, planning parameters, net requirements, and integration with supply chain processes.Experience with MRP, APS, ERP, and/or demand planning systems.Advanced Microsoft Excel skills are required.

Preferred

Experience with SAP, JDE, SQL, Anaplan, Blue Yonder, Power BI, or similar planning and analytical tools.Experience within Medical Device, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or another regulated industry.Experience supporting new product introductions and product lifecycle transitions.APICS and/or IBF certification.Experience with advanced forecasting methodologies and statistical forecasting tools.

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Assembly is a global omnichannel media agency that combines data, technology, and talent to drive growth for the world's leading brands. We bring together data, performance, creativity, and innovation to create smarter marketing solutions and measurable business outcomes.

Overview

Assembly is seeking a strategic, influential, and highly visible Director of Brand & Communications to elevate and protect the Assembly brand globally.

Reporting to the Global SVP of Brand, this role will lead the development and execution of Assembly's global brand strategy, corporate communications, thought leadership initiatives, executive visibility programs, and industry engagement efforts. The Director will play a critical role in shaping how Assembly is perceived by clients, employees, prospective talent, industry partners, and the broader marketplace.

This individual must be an exceptional storyteller, writer, and communicator with proven experience developing executive narratives, authoring thought leadership content and white papers, representing brands at industry events, and delivering compelling presentations to both internal and external audiences.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and highly collaborative global environment.

Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Positioning

 Reporting to the Global SVP of Brand to implement and execute Assembly's global brand strategy and positioning across the four regions, with North America being the focus.  Ensure consistent brand messaging and visual identity across all markets, channels, and stakeholder groups.  Develop compelling narratives that communicate Assembly's vision, values, capabilities, and competitive differentiation.  Act as a brand steward, ensuring all communications align with Assembly's strategic direction. 

Corporate Communications

 Lead internal and external communications initiatives that strengthen brand reputation and engagement, supporting the appropriate communication of executive voices to the global business, to a generation that consumes and receives messages different from any that have come before.  Develop executive communications, key messaging frameworks, company announcements, and strategic communications plans to reach existing and talent we want to attract – make Assembly a go to destination  Support organizational change, business transformation, and major company initiatives through effective communication strategies.  Collaborate with regional and functional leaders to ensure alignment and consistency of messaging globally. 

Thought Leadership & Content Development

 Lead Assembly's thought leadership strategy across industry, client, and media audiences.  Research, write, and oversee the development of:  White papers  Industry reports  Executive articles  Opinion pieces  Case studies  Client-facing insights  Conference presentations  Partner with subject matter experts across Media, Data, Technology, Commerce, and Analytics to translate complex topics into compelling content.  Maintain a strategic editorial calendar that supports brand and business objectives. 

Executive Visibility & Public Speaking

 Build and manage executive visibility programs for Assembly leadership.  Identify opportunities for speaking engagements, conferences, industry panels, webinars, podcasts, and media appearances.  Support senior leaders with presentation development, speech writing, talking points, and keynote content.  Serve as a visible brand ambassador capable of presenting Assembly's vision, capabilities, and thought leadership to internal and external audiences.  Represent Assembly at industry events and networking opportunities. 

Public Relations & Industry Influence

 Partner with PR agencies and media partners to strengthen Assembly's market presence alongside key identified talent  Develop proactive media and analyst relations programs.  Drive award strategies, industry recognition programs, and conference participation.  Manage responses to reputation-related communications issues when required. 

Internal Communications & Employee Engagement

 Develop communication programs that reinforce company culture, strategic priorities, and employee engagement.  Partner closely with People Operations and executive leadership on internal communication initiatives.  Support company-wide events, town halls, leadership meetings, and employee communications.  Support the development of agency merch, visual branding and ad hoc engagement efforts 

Team Leadership & Collaboration

 Lead and develop communications and content resources across the organization.  Manage external agencies, freelancers, and creative partners as needed.  Establish communication KPIs and measure the effectiveness of brand, communications, and thought leadership initiatives.  Foster a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

What Success Looks Like

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

 Strengthening Assembly's global brand awareness and reputation.  Growth in executive visibility, speaking opportunities, and industry influence.  Increased thought leadership output, including white papers, industry reports, and media placements.  Improved employee engagement through effective communication programs.  Consistent global brand execution and messaging.  Increased share of voice across key industry and client audiences.  Measurable impact on business development and market perception. 

Qualifications

Required Experience

 8-12+ years of experience in Brand, Communications, Corporate Communications, Public Relations, Content Strategy, or related disciplines.  Experience working within media, marketing, consulting, technology, professional services, or related industries.  Proven success building and executing global brand and communications strategies.  Demonstrated experience creating executive thought leadership content and publishing white papers or industry research.  Strong public speaking experience, including presenting at conferences, industry events, client forums, webinars, and executive meetings.  Experience supporting executive leadership and C-suite communications. 

Skills & Competencies

 Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling capabilities.  Outstanding verbal communication and public speaking skills.  Ability to translate complex ideas into compelling and accessible narratives.  Strong executive presence and stakeholder management skills.  Deep understanding of brand development, reputation management, and communications strategy.  Experience developing keynote presentations, speeches, and executive messaging.  Strong project management and organizational skills.  Ability to influence and collaborate across a global organization. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience within a global communications or marketing agency environment.  Experience supporting corporate transformations, mergers, acquisitions, or significant organizational change.  Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or a related field.  Master's degree preferred. 

 Footer 

Why Join Assembly?

This is an opportunity to help shape the voice, reputation, and future of one of the industry's most dynamic global agencies. You will work directly with senior leadership to bring Assembly's vision to life, amplify our thought leadership, and strengthen our position as a leading media and marketing partner worldwide.

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function

Supply Chain Planning

Job Sub Function

End-to-End Planning

Job Category

People Leader

All Job Posting Locations:

Irvine, California, United States of America

Job Description

The Senior Director, Global Demand & Americas End‑to‑End Supply Chain Lead is responsible for defining and executing the Americas regional E2E supply chain strategy for the Electrophysiology (EP) and Neurovascular (NV) businesses. This role enables sustainable growth, superior customer experience, and optimized financial performance through strong regional execution of global supply chain strategies.

The role provides end‑to‑end ownership for regional service, IBP/S&OP, planning, value stream management, and in‑market execution, while serving as the primary supply chain partner to US, LATAM, and Canada Commercial leadership. The leader orchestrates seamless cross‑functional integration across Planning, Customer Service, Digital & Technology, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, and Finance.

This leader is also responsible for the alignment of the Global Demand and Planning strategy with the Global Supply Chain strategy. The main responsibilities are to own Global Demand consolidation, lead and improve Demand Planning and IBP processes by reducing forecast error and optimizing inventory utilization across EP.

Key Responsibilities

E2E Supply Chain Strategy & Performance – Develop and deploy an Americas E2E supply chain vision and strategy aligned with global EP/NV priorities; ensure service excellence, cost competitiveness, inventory optimization, and cash flow performance.Integrated Business Planning (IBP) & S&OP Leadership – Own and continuously mature the Americas IBP and S&OE processes through executive engagement, high quality forecasting, scenario planning, and aligned decision making. Lead Global Demand Planning process.Commercial Value Creation & Deal Enablement – Partner with Americas EP/NV Commercial leadership to support growth through reliable supply, launch readiness, deal enablement, portfolio management (PMR/LCM), and demand agility.Customer‑Facing Service Ownership – Own regional service performance outcomes and customer experience; lead rapid response and issue resolution in alignment with global teams.Cross‑Functional & Operational Integration – Orchestrate seamless collaboration across Planning, Customer Service, D&T, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, and Finance to translate strategy into market and country‑level execution.People Leadership & Talent Development - Lead and develop a high‑performing planning, value stream, and in‑market supply chain organization; build leadership capability and succession pipelines.Ensure robust succession planning process and build strong talent pipelines, with focus on development plans to accelerate talent capabilities.Ensure strong training and education processes for all end-to-end planning, management and support capabilities.Build a customer focused culture.Continuous Improvement & Digitalization – Advance regional digital supply chain capabilities (ERP, OMP, analytics); drive continuous improvement, external benchmarking, and best‑practice adoption.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required, Master’s degree or MBA preferred.Minimum of 12+ years of end-to-end supply chain experience, including senior leadership roles.10+ years people management experience.Experience in medical device, healthcare, or regulated industries required.Demonstrated experience leading regional or global supply chain organizations in a highly matrixed environment.Proven success driving IBP / S&OP maturity and enterprise level decision making.Deep understanding of end-to-end supply chain, demand/supply planning, inventory, logistics, and customer service.Strong business and financial acumen with ability to balance service, cost, growth, and cash.Proven capability to lead large, cross functional programs and transformations.Ability to influence senior leaders and align diverse stakeholders with limited direct authority.Strong collaboration with Quality and Regulatory Affairs to ensure compliance and customer outcomes.APICS / IBF certification preferred.PMP, APICS or IBF, Agile, Lean, or Six Sigma certification preferred.Experience leading digital supply chain and ERP / OMP deployments preferred.

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.
