Location: Manchester City Centre, 4 days a week in the office, central Manchester

Start Date: ASAP

Duration: 6 Months initially

Daily Rate: Competitive Day Rate, Inside IR35

 Payroll provider – Rockford Payroll   Info for Contingent Workers – Rockford Pay 

This is an exciting opportunity to join Deloitte Operations for an engagement with one of our clients.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced CLO, Funds & Loan Operations Associate to support the onboarding, administration, and ongoing management of CLO and leveraged loan portfolios. The role combines deep knowledge of syndicated loan documentation, structured credit products, and loan operations with a strong focus on process improvement, automation, and data quality.

 Key responsibilities include: 

 Review and validate loan documentation, including LMA and LSTA agreements, to support asset onboarding and portfolio management.  Manage loan administration activities across CLO portfolios, ensuring accurate maintenance of positions, settlements, cashflows, and reference data.  Support CLO warehouse facilities, including funding requests, portfolio reporting, and investor reporting requirements.  Perform quality assurance and oversight of operational workflows, ensuring adherence to controls, procedures, and escalation protocols.  Utilise loan administration platforms such as Solvas, Loan IQ, Polaris, or similar systems.  Drive process improvement initiatives, leveraging automation, AI, and data analytics to increase operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.  Work closely with portfolio managers, trustees, lenders, investors, and internal stakeholders to support day-to-day portfolio operations. 

Key Skills

 CLO and Structured Credit Operations  Leveraged Loans and Syndicated Loans  LMA and LSTA Documentation  Loan Administration Platforms (Solvas, Polaris, Loan IQ)  Cashflow and Funding Management  Portfolio Reporting  Data Governance and Quality Assurance  Process Automation and AI Tools  Python and Operational Analytics  Stakeholder Management 

 Ideal Profile 

 2-5+ years' experience within CLO, leveraged loan, loan servicing, fund administration, or structured credit operations.  Strong understanding of loan lifecycle events, trade settlement, onboarding, and portfolio maintenance.  Experience working with CLO managers, fund administrators, investment banks, or asset managers.  Proven track record of improving operational processes through automation and technology.

rows.title: AI Engineer - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
rows.descriptionText:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will design and build innovative AI solutions by seamlessly combining advanced software development practices with robust data engineering expertise.

You will collaborate with a global network of technologists, data scientists, and industry experts to help clients transform their businesses through advanced analytics and AI-driven solutions. You’ll develop scalable data pipelines, build cutting-edge software products, and contribute to the development of AI models while mentoring client teams and shaping engineering cultures.

You will take on diverse and impactful responsibilities that blend technical expertise with strategic collaboration. You will architect and build scalable, modular, and reproducible data pipelines tailored for machine learning and AI applications. Additionally, you will develop software products and services from the ground up, ensuring they are maintainable, scalable, and secure. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you will assess data landscapes, ensure data quality, and prepare data for advanced analytics models. Your work will also involve managing secure data environments and contributing to research and development initiatives, as well as internal asset development, to continuously expand your technical expertise.

Beyond technical execution, you will participate in cross-functional problem-solving sessions with client leaders, helping shape their digital strategies and delivering solutions that extend beyond the product itself. A key part of your work will be mentoring client teams on engineering best practices, user-centric design, and Agile values, enabling them to build the technical capabilities and cultures necessary to sustain AI-driven solutions. Your work will address real-world challenges across industries, driving meaningful and lasting impact. By partnering with QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you will help create cutting-edge machine learning systems that accelerate AI adoption and solve complex business problems at scale.

Your Qualifications and Skills

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent experience2+ years of professional experience in building and deploying data solutions and software productsStrong coding skills in Python, with additional experience in Scala or Java being a plusExperience working with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured dataHands-on expertise in containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes for scalable production systemsFamiliarity with distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Dask), cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), and analytics libraries (e.g., pandas, numpy, matplotlib)Exposure to DevOps, DataOps, and MLOps concepts and best practices. Experience with core technologies such as Python, PySpark, SQL, Airflow, Databricks, Kedro, Dask/RAPIDS, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure)Experience with Generative AI (GenAI) or agentic systems, including building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, implementing large language models (LLMs), or integrating advanced AI frameworks is a plusExposure to AI modeling frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or Scikit-Learn, along with familiarity with AI Governance and Safety principles, including Responsible AI practices, bias and hallucination testing, and LLM safety guardrailsDemonstrated experience working collaboratively with other developers, as well as technical and non-technical people within software teamsExperience working in Agile teams, including active participation in sprint ceremoniesExceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environmentStrong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and local office language(s), with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

rows.title: Cyber - Palo Alto SecOps - Senior Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the evolving challenges and opportunities organizations face in cybersecurity. Join our Cyber practice to help clients navigate a dynamic threat landscape through solutions and managed services that simplify complexity and strengthen resilience. In this role, you will support Next-Generation Security Operations Center (SOC) capabilities, including platforms such as Cortex XSIAM, to help clients operate with confidence and proactively manage cyber risk.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Palo Alto SecOps, Senior Consultant on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for:

Leading the design and deployment of Next-Generation SOC platforms, including Cortex XSIAM, advanced detection rules, security information and event management (SIEM) ingestion, and security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR) playbooksIntegrating log and telemetry sources to support data quality, normalization, and operational visibilityDeveloping and optimizing automated response workflows for incident containment and remediationAdvising clients on threat detection use cases, automation strategies, and SOC platform capabilitiesCollaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance solutions, incorporate threat intelligence, and present findings and recommendations to client stakeholders

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a teamEffective written and verbal communication skillsMeticulous attention to detail and quality of work productAbility to build and sustain professional relationshipsAbility to lead projects or workstreamsAbility to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environmentStrong interpersonal skills and professional demeanorAbility to meet deadlinesAbility to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Defense & Resilience offering helps clients defend against advanced threats by transforming security operations through monitoring technologies, data analytics, and threat intelligence. The team helps organizations manage dynamic attack surfaces and respond to cyber incidents and business disruptions with greater speed and consistency. Through this work, we help clients prepare for, respond to, and recover from cyber events.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or another technical field4+ years of experience in cloud, network, or identity security, including 3+ years working with Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, and native security tools3+ years of experience with Security Operations tools and platforms, including Cortex XSIAM, Cortex XDR, Splunk, or similar security information and event management (SIEM) technologies3+ years of Security Operations Center experience in detection engineering, automation and playbook development, SOC maturity, log source management, data normalization, data ingestion, and data manipulation3+ years of experience with endpoint detection and response (EDR) platforms such as Microsoft Defender, Cortex XDR, or CrowdStrike, and governance, risk, or compliance work using established frameworks; Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, Certified Cybersecurity Associate, or equivalent cybersecurity certificationAbility to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

Experience with Palo Alto Networks solutions, including next-generation firewalls, Cortex, Prisma Cloud, Prisma Access, and XDRExperience evaluating differences among Security Operations vendor platforms and SIEM technologiesExperience with scripting and playbook development in a SIEM, SOAR, or security platformExperience with Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), equal-cost multi-path routing (ECMP), and network segmentation in on-premise and cloud environmentsExperience advising on solution design based on client use cases, requirements, and success criteriaPrevious consulting experience and/or advanced cybersecurity or network engineering certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), or Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

rows.title: Health Actuary Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
Join Deloitte's Human Capital practice as an Actuarial Consultant and help clients address complex challenges across the health care ecosystem. In this role, you will support strategic and technical consulting engagements for health plans, providers, pharmacy benefit managers, and federal and state government clients. You will contribute to actuarial modeling, financial analysis, and project delivery efforts that help organizations make informed business and policy decisions. If you are looking to apply actuarial skills in a fast-paced, client-service environment, this role offers the opportunity to make an impact across meaningful health care initiatives.

Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As an Actuarial Consultant on the Insights, Innovation & Operate team, you will be responsible for supporting strategic and technical consulting services for health plans, providers, federal and state governments, and pharmacy benefit managers.

 Develop structured query language (SQL) models to price health plan benefit changes, network changes, or other detailed claims analytics  Use strategic thinking to shape the direction of health insurers, including pricing, market entry, network design, and cost of care initiatives to drive performance  Review Medicare Advantage (MA) and Part D bid submissions for accuracy and consistency  Analyze lapse and retention rates and prepare findings for client review  Support project delivery by preparing work plans, reports, presentations, and actuarial models, including incurred but not reported (IBNR) analyses and return on investment (ROI) assessments 

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

 Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team  Effective written and verbal communication skills  Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product  Ability to build and sustain professional relationships  Ability to lead projects or workstreams  Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment  Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor  Ability to meet deadlines  Ability to provide clear guidance to others 

The Team

Insights, Innovation, and Operate

Our Insights, Innovation & Operate Offering is designed to enhance key aspects of our clients' businesses by leveraging cutting-edge technology, data, and a blend of deep technical and human expertise. We innovate and deliver creative, industry-specific solutions that streamline operations and accelerate speed-to-value.

Qualifications

Required:

 Bachelor's degree  2+ years of health actuarial experience  2 actuarial exams passed  Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.  Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. 

Preferred:

 2+ years of consulting experience and/or experience with a health plan or insurance company  1+ year of experience in health actuarial analysis, underwriting, or health care finance  1 year of experience with health plan design, alternative delivery systems, or health care reform analysis  1 year of experience with reimbursement mechanisms or payment models  1 year of experience developing client deliverables, including reports and presentations  1 year of experience using Microsoft Office products, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

rows.descriptionText:
General Information

Requisition # 693

Locations USA-VA-Arlington

Posting Date 05/06/2026

Security Clearance Required - Active Public Trust

Remote Type Hybrid (Washington DC Metro)

Time Type Full time

Description & Requirements

Elder Research Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of MANTECH international Corporation seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Data Scientist to join our team in Arlington, VA. This is a hybrid position with several days onsite per month as needed.

You'll support a U.S. federal civilian agency that serves as the central authority on human capital across the federal workforce, helping advance strategic goals around modernizing its use of data, building a stronger analytics workforce across government, delivering trusted human-capital data products to agencies and employees, and strengthening data governance, privacy, and security.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Develop, deploy, and maintain production ML and NLP models that surface insights from large volumes of human-capital and workforce data, directly supporting decisions made by federal agencies, employees, and the public.Build and modernize data products and pipelines that improve data access, integration, and quality across legacy and cloud-based systems.Translate ambiguous policy and program questions into well-scoped analytical work, partnering with non-technical stakeholders and presenting results in ways decision-makers can act on.Contribute to a modern, cloud-first technology stack (Azure ecosystem) that meets federal standards for security, privacy, and governance.Help strengthen the client's internal data-science capability through pairing, code review, knowledge transfer, and reusable tooling.

Minimum Qualifications

2–3 years of experience developing, deploying, and maintaining large-scale ML models in production using real-world dataBachelor’s degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative fieldHands-on experience building and evaluating NLP-based machine learning modelsStrong Python skills for developing and automating ML models and data pipelinesProficiency with collaborative development tools (VS Code, Git, GitHub Copilot)Experience working in Agile teams to iteratively develop and deliver data productsStrong analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, including translating ambiguous requirements into actionable solutions

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using Azure cloud products such as Azure Databricks, Azure DevOps, Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Search.Experience delivering data-science work in a federal or other regulated environment, with awareness of FedRAMP, FISMA, or similar compliance regimes.Experience working with human-capital, workforce, survey, or other administrative-record data.Experience with MLOps tooling and patterns for monitoring, retraining, and governing models in production.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply for a position with Elder Research, please email us at careers@elderresearch.com and provide your name and contact information.

rows.title: FP&A Advise Senior Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
Insurance finance leaders today face disruption from artificial intelligence, market volatility, and regulatory change, such as IFRS 17 and LDTI. As an FP&A Senior Consultant focused on the insurance industry, you will help insurance carriers strengthen financial planning, forecasting, and analytics capabilities so they can make more informed business decisions. This role supports finance transformation efforts for life and annuity (L&A), property and casualty (P&C), specialty and reinsurance organizations by combining process improvement, data enhancement, and technology innovation to deliver timely, actionable insights across the enterprise.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/24/26

Work you'll do

As an FP&A Senior Consultant within the Insurance Finance Transformation team, you will be responsible for:

 Leading financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and reporting transformation projects for insurance carriers' finance organizations Driving finance transformation initiatives across planning, analytics, management reporting, and decision support processes for L&A, P&C, specialty and reinsurance carriers Developing financial models, scenario analyses, and performance insights (including loss ratio, combined ratio, expense ratio, and reserve/premium trend analysis against external and macroeconomic impacts) to support strategic and operational decisions Collaborating with actuarial, investments, underwriting, claims, and other client stakeholders to assess current-state finance processes and design scalable future-state solutions Supporting the implementation and adoption of data, automation, and artificial intelligence capabilities within FP&A processes Supporting alignment between statutory (NAIC), US GAAP, IFRS and capital (e.g., RBC, BSCR, etc.) reporting requirements within FP&A planning and forecasting processes Designing and facilitating client workshops (from preparation through execution) to drive design decisions and advance stakeholder thinking on future-state processes Managing work plans and timelines across multiple concurrent workstreams to drive deliverables to closure

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

 Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team Effective written and verbal communication skills Present to key internal and client stakeholders, including meeting facilitation activities Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Deep understanding of an insurance carrier income statement, balance sheet, liquidity and capital financial statements and analytics Deep understanding of insurance-specific financial concepts, including loss reserves, reinsurance ceding, premium recognition, and combined ratio Familiarity with regulatory reporting requirements of an insurance company, including NAIC statutory reporting and IFRS 17/LDTI Familiarity with actuarial concepts and terminology, and ability to collaborate effectively with actuarial teams SQL, Python, or Alteryx based data prep/automation Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreams including project management activities (e.g., status tracking, RAID documentation, key design decisioning) Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Finance Transformation offering helps insurance finance and global business services leaders navigate an increasingly challenging environment marked by disruptive tech like AI, market uncertainty, and regulatory change, including IFRS 17, LDTI, and evolving statutory requirements, and recognize the opportunity to better serve the enterprise, shareholders, customers, and regulators.

Within that offering, our Insurance Business Finance team helps insurance carriers drive strategic value through financial planning, forecasting, and analytics capabilities, with a focus on earnings improvement, expense management, and capital and reserve planning. By leveraging next-gen processes, scalable data platforms, and AI, our team delivers accurate, timely, and actionable insights to life, annuity, P&C, and reinsurance clients.

Qualifications

Required:

 Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business administration, or a quantitative field 5+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, corporate finance, finance transformation, or business finance 3+ years of experience within the insurance industry, ideally in FP&A, actuarial finance, capital management, investor relations or corporate finance 2+ years of experience building financial models, forecasts, budgets, and variance analyses 2+ years of experience with enterprise resource planning systems, enterprise performance management tools, or data visualization tools 2+ years of experience leading workstreams, project teams, or finance transformation initiatives Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

 Master of Business Administration (MBA) or master's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or analytics Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), or Certified Management Accountant (CMA) Experience with Anaplan, Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), SAP Analytics Cloud, OneStream, Tableau, or Power BI Experience designing planning, forecasting, management reporting, or driver-based planning processes for insurance carriers Experience applying automation, advanced analytics, or artificial intelligence in finance workflows Experience with insurance-specific KPIs such as loss ratio, combined ratio, expense ratio, RBC ratio and persistency Experience in consulting or professional services environments supporting insurance industry finance organizations

rows.title: Staff Software Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Staff Architect II / Tech Lead – 

Demand Generation | Artemis

What Makes Us a Great Place To Work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

Who You’ll Work With

You’ll join Coro, Bain’s persistent product development and engineering organization supporting our digital solutions across Commercial Excellence and the newly established Demand Generation Suite. Coro brings together technology, data, and services to build and operate proprietary solutions that create differentiated value for our clients and case teams.

Within Coro, you’ll be part of the newly established business-to-consumer pillar, helping build the technical foundation for Artemis—Bain’s AI-driven marketing and commercial investment allocation platform and one of three products within the Demand Generation Suite.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers, AI Engineers, Full Stack Engineers, Data Science teams, the Head of Engineering, and broader product leadership to shape and deliver the Artemis platform.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

As a Staff Architect II / Tech Lead, you’ll own the technical architecture, engineering quality, and day-to-day engineering leadership for the Artemis product workstream.

You’ll be the senior engineer and team lead, partnering with the Product Lead to make key design decisions and recommend technical approaches. You’ll define how data moves through the platform, shape the AI agent architecture, establish how services integrate with Bain’s broader technology platform, and set engineering standards across the workstream.

This is an opportunity to help shape a high-impact product from the ground up while remaining hands-on with its development. Alongside writing code, you’ll lead the team’s delivery cadence, remove blockers, maintain momentum against the roadmap, and help other engineers grow.

What You’ll Do

Architecture and technical governance

Define and document the architecture for the Artemis workstream, ensuring alignment with the shared Demand Generation Suite platform design and Bain-wide Azure infrastructure.Make key technical design decisions across data flows, service boundaries, and integration patterns.Own the engineering quality bar for the workstream, including code reviews, test coverage expectations, pull request standards, and documentation practices.Ensure the team produces maintainable solutions that can be supported by a distributed engineering organization.Create, communicate, and maintain technical designs, architecture artifacts, best practices, and engineering principles for both technical and executive audiences.

Platform integration

Manage integration points between Artemis, other Demand Generation Suite applications, and Bain’s wider technology platform.Define and maintain API contracts, agent and skill registry contributions, and shared user interface components.Support Artemis integrations with Bayesian marketing mix modelling capabilities and campaign performance data pipelines.Partner with AI Engineers to design large language model orchestration and tool-calling architectures for Artemis-specific agents, with a focus on reliability, maintainability, and cost efficiency at scale.

Roadmap delivery and team leadership

Partner with Product Managers to translate prioritized initiatives into clear technical scopes, estimate complexity, identify dependencies, and sequence work across the team.Own sprint-level task assignment, remove blockers, and help the team deliver against committed timelines and roadmap priorities.Lead the workstream engineering team, including technical stand-ups, workload management, and structured feedback.Support the growth of junior team members while maintaining a strong pace of delivery.Work effectively with stakeholders across all levels of the organization.Support recruiting activities, including resume screening and interviews.

Innovation and emerging technologies

Explore new approaches to complex business and technical challenges.Participate in technical discovery, proofs of concept, and innovation workstreams to assess new tools, technologies, and designs.Stay current on emerging developments across data, AI, and AI-agent technologies, and share relevant knowledge with the wider team.Bring an entrepreneurial mindset and a willingness to test new approaches.Turn ambiguous requirements into well-scoped engineering work within a consulting-adjacent product environment.

About You

Essential experience and capabilities

8–10+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years as a staff architect or technical team lead responsible for delivering large features or complete products.Experience in software and data architecture within a senior technology leadership role.A track record of building and operating scalable, cloud-based business-to-business software products.Strong Python backend engineering experience using FastAPI or an equivalent asynchronous framework.Proficiency in TypeScript and React, with the ability to work effectively across the full technology stack.Deep experience with cloud-native architecture on Azure, including Azure Container Apps, Azure Functions, infrastructure-as-code, and containerized deployments using Docker.Working knowledge of large language model APIs and agent orchestration frameworks, with the ability to make sound design decisions around agent structure, tool calling, and prompt management.Working knowledge of data pipeline architecture, including SQL schemas, extract-transform-load pipelines, analytical data stores, and data quality frameworks.Deep experience in either developing AI agents—including long-running or workflow-based agents—or data engineering in large-scale, complex environments.Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams in a fast-paced Agile environment.A track record of delivering successfully in Agile environments.Experience managing engineering teams, including resolving conflicts and dependencies.Demonstrated ability to manage communication across project stakeholders and external vendors.Experience translating ambiguous requirements—including statistical model outputs and marketing return-on-investment workflows—into well-scoped engineering work.Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate across different levels of an organization.An analytical, creative, proactive, and results-oriented approach.An entrepreneurial mindset and comfort experimenting with new approaches.Familiarity with AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex.An Associate or Bachelor’s degree, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

Preferred Experience

Significant experience working with marketing, media, or advertising data, including familiarity with marketing mix modelling inputs such as spend, channel, and campaign data and how they are structured and used in analytics or measurement workflows.Experience working directly with Data Science teams to translate statistical model outputs into scalable product features.

rows.descriptionText:
Insurance finance leaders today face disruption from artificial intelligence, market volatility, and regulatory change, such as IFRS 17 and LDTI. As an FP&A Senior Consultant focused on the insurance industry, you will help insurance carriers strengthen financial planning, forecasting, and analytics capabilities so they can make more informed business decisions. This role supports finance transformation efforts for life and annuity (L&A), property and casualty (P&C), specialty and reinsurance organizations by combining process improvement, data enhancement, and technology innovation to deliver timely, actionable insights across the enterprise.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/24/26

Work you'll do

As an FP&A Senior Consultant within the Insurance Finance Transformation team, you will be responsible for:

Job Description

Energy and Commodities (E&C) Trading organisations have invested heavily in E/CTRM platforms over the last two decades. Yet the organisations creating real competitive advantage today are not simply the ones with the best trading systems. They are the ones building the data ecosystems, user experiences and intelligent decision-support capabilities around them. As the industry accelerates towards AI-enabled operations and increasingly data-driven trading models, the focus is shifting from system implementation to enterprise-wide trading transformation.

Publicis Sapient partners with many of the world s leading Energy Trading organisations to navigate that shift. Our teams work across the full trading technology landscape, helping clients modernise ETRM estates, architect data-led ecosystems and unlock greater value from their trading platforms. This creates opportunities for experienced practitioners to apply their expertise beyond traditional package implementation, influencing how the next generation of trading organisations operate, scale and compete.

Senior Energy Trading Business SME - Director - Energy & Commodities

As Senior Energy Trading Business SME at Publicis Sapient, you will bring deep expertise in Physical Commodities trading - across Crude, Refined Products, Gas and Power - and physical trading operations to help some of the world s leading energy organisations navigate complex business and technology transformation programmes. Acting as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders, you will help shape future-state trading processes, operating models and ETRM-enabled capabilities across the energy value chain.

This role is suited to practitioners who have spent time inside physical supply and trading functions – in front office, operations, scheduling or middle office – and can combine that first-hand experience with strong working knowledge of one or more leading ETRM platforms.

Qualifications

Your Skills and Experience

Set Yourself Apart With

Wellness program and employee assistance.Generous paid leave and holidays.Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family.Flexibility to support work-life balance.Competitive compensation and benefits package.Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities.An inclusive workplace that promotes diversity and collaboration.

rows.descriptionText:
At KPMG, you can become an integral part of a dynamic team at one of the top tax firms in the world. Enjoy a collaborative, future-forward culture that empowers your success. Work with KPMGs extensive network of specialists and enjoy access to our Ignition Centers, where deep industry knowledge merges with cutting-edge technologies to create innovative tax solutions. Join a diverse team helping high-profile clients understand, analyze and respond to complex business opportunities and challenges. Develop your career through a range of multifaceted engagements, formal training and informal mentoring. At KPMG, we put our culture and values front and center.

KPMG is currently seeking a Tax Associate to join our International Tax practice.

Responsibilities:

Team with colleagues to advise multinational enterprises on tax matters relating to cross-border transactions and other business decisions, such as where to operate, how to optimize global supply chains and how to access and mobilize capital to fund global operationsProvide tax structuring advice to asset management and strategic corporate clients that engage in mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, dispositions and initial public offerings in the context of cross-border transactions; support clients with internal restructuring transactionsLearn about changes in tax law (through KPMG provided training and materials, as well as independent study) and advise clients regarding the impact of those changes on their business; provide recommendations to address potential risks or realize opportunitiesPrepare international tax elements of the tax provision calculation for our clients' financial statements and international tax elements of U.S. federal income tax returns for our clientsAssist KPMG audit teams with their audit of financial statements, including consideration of tax implications arising from global operations and transactionsPrepare deliverables such as tax calculations (or ""models""), slide decks, memorandums, or emails with coaching and direction provided by other engagement team membersBuild capabilities in key technologies that enable tax professionals for client service delivery such as artificial intelligence (AI), Alteryx, Power BI, and more

Qualifications:

Must be pursuing and have obtained by the start date or have completed the following degrees/majors in the past 12 months: a JD and/or LLM in Taxation, or equivalent program from an accredited college or universityPreferred GPA of 3.0 or abovePreferred undergraduate degree and/or areas of study: business, accounting, finance, taxation, mathematics, economics, information technology, computer science, data and analytics, engineering (financial, industrial or systems), or equivalent program from an accredited college or universityCoursework or minor in information systems, software engineering, computer science or data and analytics preferredInterest and exposure to a broad range of U.S. international and domestic tax law provisionsStrong in technical, business acumen, critical thinking and agility skills. Demonstrated ability to excel and drive strategic outcomes, coupled with a professional demeanor and a collaborative leadership approach, in a dynamic, evolving environmentDemonstrated quality service mindset, strong technical aptitude, ability to learn and navigate technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), Alteryx and Power BI, MS Office Applications including Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook and apply emerging technologies to enhance tax processes and insightsExcellent communication, time management and leadership skills, feedback oriented, and resourceful in delivering high quality workMust reside within a reasonably commutable distance to the office for this position and be able to travel to reasonably commutable work locations using own means of transportation, such as a personal vehicle or public transportationAbility to travel and/or work on-site at client premises as needed, at times with relatively short noticeMust be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

rows.title: Sales Director - Microsoft
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Role Overview

As a Director of Business Development, you will operate as a senior individual contributor within Publicis Sapient Microsoft Practice, responsible for driving net-new revenue and expanding strategic accounts aligned to the Microsoft ecosystem.

This is a quota-carrying role, with primary accountability for originating, shaping, and closing large, complex digital transformation deals. You will engage directly with C-level stakeholders, lead end-to-end sales cycles, and build trusted client relationships that translate into long-term revenue growth.

While you will collaborate closely with Microsoft field teams and internal go-to-market functions, your success will be defined by your ability to generate pipeline, convert opportunities, and consistently deliver against revenue targets.

Qualifications

Skills & Experience

Significant experience in enterprise sales, business development, or client partner roles within technology, consulting, or digital transformation servicesProven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding individual revenue quotasDemonstrated success closing large, complex enterprise deals (multi-million-dollar transformation programs)Strong ability to originate net-new business and engage senior stakeholders in new and existing accountsExperience managing end-to-end sales cycles in highly matrixed organizationsDeep understanding of the Microsoft ecosystem, including Azure, Data & AI, and/or Dynamics 365, and how these solutions enable business outcomesExperience leveraging Microsoft co-sell motions and field relationships to drive pipeline and close revenueStrong commercial acumen, with the ability to structure deals, articulate value, and influence executive decision-makersExcellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate technology solutions into measurable business impact

Set Yourself Apart With

Experience converting Microsoft-influenced opportunities into closed revenueFamiliarity with Microsoft commercial constructs, partner programs, and funding mechanisms to accelerate deal economicsBackground in cloud transformation, data platforms, AI/ML, or enterprise applicationsEstablished relationships within the Microsoft field sales or partner ecosystemExperience selling across industry verticals in large enterprise environments

Join us in the brave pursuit of next.

Publicis Sapient

Additional Information

Pay Range: $180,000 - $240,000

The range shown represents a grouping of relevant ranges currently in use at Publicis Sapient. Actual range for this position may differ, depending on location and specific skillset required for the work itself. Benefits of working here: Flexible vacation policy; time is not limited, allocated, or accrued 16 paid holidays throughout the year Generous parental leave and new parent transition program Tuition reimbursement Corporate gift matching program

As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hiring@publicis.sapient.com. Your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Company Description

Publicis Sapient is a global digital transformation partner that, for more than 30 years, has guided some of the world s largest organisations toward a digitally enabled future, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting and customer experience with agile engineering and Data problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of Next.

Our teams combine deep industry expertise with our SPEED capabilities, Strategy, Product, Experience, Engineering, and Data & AI to tackle the biggest challenges clients are facing today. This is where transformation stops being a buzzword and becomes measurable outcomes for millions of members.

Our 20,000+ professionals in 70 offices worldwide combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses by designing the products and services their customers truly value. Our people are problem-solvers and collaborators, leveraging human ingenuity and AI-driven tools to drive innovation.

rows.title: Principal, Management Consulting - Healthcare, Payer
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Job Description

As a Principal, you will actively participate in the growth and development of the Management Consulting practice at Publicis Sapient. Your role will focus on shaping ambitious Digital Business Transformations for our clients within the healthcare payer industry, delivering strategic advice throughout the transformation lifecycle. You will work alongside multidisciplinary teams of management consultants, experience strategists, and technology engineers to solve complex business challenges for leading health plans.

We are seeking experienced management consultants with deep healthcare payer expertise who have successfully led client engagements, managed consulting teams, and partnered with executive stakeholders to deliver measurable business outcomes.

Qualifications

Your Impact

Lead large-scale digital and business transformation engagements for healthcare payer clients.Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client executives, developing strategic recommendations that improve operational performance, member experience, and business value.Manage and mentor multidisciplinary consulting teams, ensuring high-quality delivery and professional development of team members.Actively contribute to the growth of the Management Consulting practice by supporting recruiting, mentoring consultants, defining best practices, and developing thought leadership.Collaborate across strategy, customer experience, data, and technology teams to deliver innovative transformation solutions.Work with and learn from key strategy consulting leaders, in a cross-functional environment.Heavy focus on how AI will transform the healthcare industry and Fortune 500 companies.Exponential growth and change in how strategy teams leverage ai to accelerate outcomes.Build and maintain strong executive-level client relationships while identifying opportunities to expand engagements.

Qualifications

Skills & Experience

8+ years of Strategy and/or Management Consulting experience, preferably with a global consulting firm.Demonstrated consulting experience serving healthcare payer organizations.Experience leading large-scale business and digital transformation initiatives for healthcare payer clients.Proven experience managing consulting teams, leading workstreams, and mentoring consultants across multiple engagements.Strong executive presence with experience advising C-suite and senior healthcare executives.Excellent written, verbal, analytical, and presentation skills.Exceptional structured problem-solving and quantitative analysis capabilities.Experience with operating model transformation, business process improvement, or enterprise strategy within healthcare.Appreciation for Agile ways of working and technology-enabled transformation.Ability to build trusted client relationships and deliver measurable business value.Willingness to travel to client sites as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with health plans across Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or ACA Exchange lines of business.Knowledge of healthcare payer operations including Claims, Enrollment, Member Services, Provider Operations, Care Management, Utilization Management, Payment Integrity, Value-Based Care, and Digital Member Experience.Experience leading technology-enabled transformations involving modernization, cloud, data & analytics, AI, or customer experience initiatives.

Additional Information

Pay Range: $180,000 - $220,000

The range shown represents a grouping of relevant ranges currently in use at Publicis Sapient. Actual range for this position may differ, depending on location and specific skillset required for the work itself. Benefits of working here: Flexible vacation policy; time is not limited, allocated, or accrued 16 paid holidays throughout the year Generous parental leave and new parent transition program Tuition reimbursement Corporate gift matching program

As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hiring@publicis.sapient.com. Your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Company Description

Publicis Sapient (“PS”) is a leader in the digital transformation space, helping the best brands in the world get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. Fueled by a recognized heritage in large-scale IT and engineering, we combine market-leading capabilities in strategy, technology & engineering, platforming, experience design and more. We deliver ideas through execution across the ten business sectors in which we operate.

As digital pioneers with 20,000 people and 53 offices around the globe, our experience spanning technology, data sciences, consulting and customer obsession is amplified by our parent company, Publicis Groupe, the world’s largest multinational communications and marketing organization. Our culture is one of curiosity and relentlessness, and we embrace diversity and reward imagination. We seek achievers, leaders and visionaries, and our team looks to each person to bring skills and passion to help our clients solve their biggest business challenges.

rows.title: Tax Associate, International Tax - JD/LLM | Multiple Locations Summer/Fall 2027
rows.descriptionText:
At KPMG, you can become an integral part of a dynamic team at one of the top tax firms in the world. Enjoy a collaborative, future-forward culture that empowers your success. Work with KPMGs extensive network of specialists and enjoy access to our Ignition Centers, where deep industry knowledge merges with cutting-edge technologies to create innovative tax solutions. Join a diverse team helping high-profile clients understand, analyze and respond to complex business opportunities and challenges. Develop your career through a range of multifaceted engagements, formal training and informal mentoring. At KPMG, we put our culture and values front and center.

KPMG is currently seeking a Tax Associate to join our International Tax practice.

Responsibilities:

Team with colleagues to advise multinational enterprises on tax matters relating to cross-border transactions and other business decisions, such as where to operate, how to optimize global supply chains and how to access and mobilize capital to fund global operationsProvide tax structuring advice to asset management and strategic corporate clients that engage in mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, dispositions and initial public offerings in the context of cross-border transactions; support clients with internal restructuring transactionsLearn about changes in tax law (through KPMG provided training and materials, as well as independent study) and advise clients regarding the impact of those changes on their business; provide recommendations to address potential risks or realize opportunitiesPrepare international tax elements of the tax provision calculation for our clients' financial statements and international tax elements of U.S. federal income tax returns for our clientsAssist KPMG audit teams with their audit of financial statements, including consideration of tax implications arising from global operations and transactionsPrepare deliverables such as tax calculations (or ""models""), slide decks, memorandums, or emails with coaching and direction provided by other engagement team membersBuild capabilities in key technologies that enable tax professionals for client service delivery such as artificial intelligence (AI), Alteryx, Power BI, and more

Qualifications:

Must be pursuing and have obtained by the start date or have completed the following degrees/majors in the past 12 months: a JD and/or LLM in Taxation, or equivalent program from an accredited college or universityPreferred GPA of 3.0 or abovePreferred undergraduate degree and/or areas of study: business, accounting, finance, taxation, mathematics, economics, information technology, computer science, data and analytics, engineering (financial, industrial or systems), or equivalent program from an accredited college or universityCoursework or minor in information systems, software engineering, computer science or data and analytics preferredInterest and exposure to a broad range of U.S. international and domestic tax law provisionsStrong in technical, business acumen, critical thinking and agility skills. Demonstrated ability to excel and drive strategic outcomes, coupled with a professional demeanor and a collaborative leadership approach, in a dynamic, evolving environmentDemonstrated quality service mindset, strong technical aptitude, ability to learn and navigate technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), Alteryx and Power BI, MS Office Applications including Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook and apply emerging technologies to enhance tax processes and insightsExcellent communication, time management and leadership skills, feedback oriented, and resourceful in delivering high quality workMust reside within a reasonably commutable distance to the office for this position and be able to travel to reasonably commutable work locations using own means of transportation, such as a personal vehicle or public transportationAbility to travel and/or work on-site at client premises as needed, at times with relatively short noticeMust be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

In addition, KPMG is proud to offer a comprehensive, competitive benefits package, with options designed to help you make the best decisions for yourself, your family, and your lifestyle. Available benefits are based on eligibility. rows.title: Consulting Marketing Lead - Industry
rows.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

Growth Marketing Lead - Industry 

ZS is seeking a Growth Marketing Lead to support and expand our industry practices outside of healthcare by translating business priorities into differentiated industry positioning, thought leadership, content strategies, and go-to-market initiatives that drive awareness, engagement, and business growth.

You will operate at the intersection of strategy, execution, and analytics, partnering with business leaders and marketing & communications ecosystem partners to deliver coordinated, measurable marketing outcomes.

You will lead marketing strategy, industry positioning, and narrative development, holding accountability for messaging, market differentiation, and marketing's contribution to business growth, pipeline, and revenue.

The role will also shape ZS's external industry presence through strategic event participation, thought leadership activation, and executive engagement programs that strengthen brand visibility, client relationships, and growth opportunities.

This is a high-visibility role which requires strong interpersonal and team skills as well as abalance of strategic leadership, cross-functional influence, and operational excellence. You will exhibit strong external presence with industry stakeholders, and an ability to influence across the organization. You will ensure that ZS’s capabilities and assets resonate with the industry and target audience (accounts and personas) to increase ZS’s visibility, brand equity and trust.

What You’ll Do:

Industry go-to-market planning and execution

Develop a deep understanding of ZS’s industry capabilities and competitive landscape Partner with industry SMEs to manage plan and campaign deliveryTranslate business priorities, market opportunities, and client needs into industry positioning, growth strategies, and integrated go-to-market plans.Develop integrated event activation strategies that align event investments to industry growth objectives, account priorities, and campaign goals.Define industry-specific value propositions, messaging frameworks, and market narratives that differentiate ZS and support business growth.

Campaign & Content Activation

Shape industry marketing strategy and priority initiatives by defining narratives, content priorities, and engagement approaches that support growth objectives.Conduct market, customer, and competitive analysis to identify emerging trends and opportunities, and messaging recommendations.Develop and operationalize flagship POVs, articles, webinars, and conversion assets Partner with SMEs to translate complex industry topics into clear, compelling storiesDevelop positioning, messaging, sales enablement materials, and playbooks that support business development efforts and strengthen industry differentiation.Deliver high-quality campaign and asset execution with strong attention to detail Manage multiple workstreams with clear timelines and accountability Support activation of campaigns through sales channels and account-based motions Develop event-specific narratives, thought leadership themes, executive messaging, and content strategies that reinforce industry positioning and differentiation. Partner with SMEs and business leaders to shape speaking opportunities, session concepts, executive engagements, and client-facing experiences.

Performance Tracking & Insights

Monitor campaign performance against defined KPIs (awareness, consideration, conversion)Use insights to optimize targeting, messaging, and channel mixSupport reporting on marketing impact and ROIMaintain structured documentation of campaigns, assets and outcomes Maintain accountability for MyCRM utilization and reporting to ensure visibility into marketing-driven and influenced impact 

What You’ll Bring:

6+ years of marketing experience in B2B marketing, consulting, or related fieldStrong project management and ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneouslyComfort working cross-functionally in a matrixed environment, influencing without direct authority.Excellent relationship-building and communication skills, able to engage senior stakeholders internally and externally.Experience developing market positioning, value propositions, and executive-level messaging for complex B2B offerings.Demonstrated ability to influence business strategy through customer, competitive, and market insights.Ability to operate as a strategic advisor and thought partner to senior business leaders.Experience translating business objectives into marketing strategy, industry narratives, and growth initiatives.Ability to translate business objectives into structured marketing plansStrong analytical thinking and ability to solve ambiguous, cross-functional problemsProven experience delivering end-to-end marketing programs or campaignsAbility to develop clear, concise, executive-ready messaging and materialsSkilled in translating technical/complex topics into compelling narrativesDemonstrated ability to align event investments with business objectives, brand positioning, relationship development, and pipeline growth. Strong stakeholder management skills with experience coordinating across business leaders, sales teams, SMEs, external partners, and event organizers.Fluency in EnglishClient-first mentalityIntense work ethicCollaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

Work Authorization:

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

Find Out More At:

www.zs.com

rows.title: Data Excellence Delivery & BD Lead - ZS Discovery
rows.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. ZS's Insights & Analytics group partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.   

ZS Discovery partners with pharmaceutical and biotech clients to accelerate the discovery of safer, more effective therapeutics. The team brings hands-on scientific expertise, advanced analytics, AI, and strategic consulting to help research organizations become more productive, more data-driven, and more confident in their decisions. As a venture within ZS building toward practice status, Discovery combines agility and innovation with the resources and knowledge of the broader firm.

You will coordinate with offshore delivery teams on implementation workstreamsContribute to business development: identify growth opportunities within accounts, shape proposals and scopes of work, and bring informed perspectives on where discovery organizations are headedHelp build ZSD’s Drug Discovery practice by developing offerings, IP, case examples, and market-facing thought leadershipFactor AI and data-readiness into your recommendations. You will not build AI models, but you will need to translate emerging AI and data trends into practical client action

What You’ll Bring:

Advanced degree preferred in life sciences, chemistry, biology, bioinformatics, biomedical engineering, data science, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent is also valued. Not required if domain depth is evident from experience Roughly 8-10+ years of relevant experience in consulting, pharma/biotech R&D, research IT, discovery informatics, or a combinationDirect experience working in or with drug discovery and/or preclinical research organizationsFamiliarity with scientific data domains relevant to discovery, such as assay data, omics, chemistry, biology, imaging, DMPK, or translational dataExperience with platforms and ecosystems used in research organizations, such as ELN/LIMS, scientific workflow tools, cloud data platforms, knowledge graphs, AI/ML workflows, or bioinformatics environmentsExperience leading transformation programs in research settings (not just administering platforms). Ability to manage stakeholder alignment between IT and research functions, adoption challenges, workflow designExperience contributing to or leading sales/business development activities: shaping proposals, scoping extensions, or identifying new opportunities within existing accountsUnderstanding of data architecture, platform selection, integration patterns, and data governance well enough to evaluate technical trade-offs and guide delivery teams. Ability to connect discovery workflows with data and platform decisionsDemonstrated ability to bridge the language of scientists, informaticians, and business leaders. Comfortability presenting to heads of discovery, research informatics, computational sciences, and digital/data leadershipFluency in EnglishClient-first mentalityIntense work ethicCollaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

rows.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, ML Platform
rows.descriptionText:

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

At Snap, the Technical Program Manager (TPM) is not a traditional project coordinator—this is a strategic, high-leverage leadership role designed for deep technical operators who thrive at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, data analytics, and program execution. TPMs at Snap are single-threaded owners of large-scale, high-stakes, and often ambiguous programs. They combine engineering depth with execution precision, earning visibility and trust across the company by driving outcomes that power the core of our products and infrastructure. Unlike industry-standard TPM roles, Snap TPMs are hands-on contributors who write Python notebooks, build dashboards and automation tools, and partner closely with engineering leaders to shape technical roadmaps, make architectural trade-offs, and drive the operating rhythm of the business. The most successful TPMs possess the ability to grasp new concepts quickly, navigate technical complexity, and adapt in fast-moving environments. This role is ideal for former engineers or data scientists who have evolved into program leaders without leaving their technical roots behind.

Our interview process reflects the technical rigor and strategic impact expected of TPMs at Snap. Unlike typical program management interviews, our process is designed to evaluate candidates’ ability to think like engineers and act like owners. Candidates begin with an introductory conversation with the hiring manager, followed by a technical screen that dives into core program execution and engineering fundamentals. From there, candidates complete a hands-on data analytics assessment via HackerRank, where they write executable Python and SQL code to analyze real-world data problems. The final stage is a virtual onsite, which includes a program leadership presentation and three 1:1 interviews with senior leaders across Snap. Throughout, we assess not only communication and collaboration skills but also technical fluency, first-principles thinking, and the ability to drive strategic outcomes in complex, ambiguous environments.

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) at Snap, you will:

Lead complex, cross-functional programs that span multiple engineering organizations and require deep technical understanding, rigorous execution, and strategic influence. Operate as a single-threaded owner (STO) for the most critical programs, managing ambiguity, dependencies, and alignment across diverse technical teams. Own the full lifecycle of programs—from ideation to execution to operational excellence—delivering outcomes that support Snap’s product, infrastructure, and platform goals. Partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape roadmaps, influence technical decisions, and drive accountability. Use hands-on data analytics (Python, SQL, dashboards, notebooks) to guide programs with data, uncover insights, and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders. Contribute to Snap’s technical ecosystem by building automation tools, improving internal systems, and identifying opportunities for platform-wide transformation. Work across both development programs (spanning multiple orgs with complex interdependencies) and platform excellence programs (focused on reliability, efficiency, and performance). Drive the operating rhythm of the business, ensuring engineering systems scale effectively while remaining cost-conscious and performantMentor and grow other junior TPMs and Engineers to scale the performance of the org

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's in a technical field such as computer science, mathematics, statistics or equivalent years of experience11+ years of experience spanning Engineering / Data Science / Technical Program Management leading cross-functional efforts in the software or tech industry in a data-driven environment. 5+ years of experience in Technical Program Management . A proven track record of leading large-scale, ambiguous programs across distributed teams in fast-paced, cross-functional environments, especially in the areas of improving platform reliability, operational stability and performance of production systemsStrong proficiency with Python and SQL, and experience using data to analyze systems, build tools, or inform decisions. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Grafana, Looker, Tableau) building dashboards, source control (e.g. GitHub), ticket management (e.g. JIRA). Comfort operating with high visibility and accountability; you thrive on ownership and impact. Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new domains, systems, and technologies. Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.

Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP) and containerization tools like Kubernetes or Docker. Deep understanding of ML development workflows, model lifecycle management, or experimentation frameworks. rows.descriptionText:
Meta's Infrastructure Silicon organization is building custom ASICs to power the compute demands of AI, data center, and next-generation platform workloads. We are looking for an experienced Silicon Validation Engineer to join our team, working across the full silicon lifecycle from early pre-silicon design input and FPGA emulation to post-silicon bring-up, characterization, and deployment in the production fleet. You will play a central role in validating custom silicon, driving emulation bring-up, and leading debug efforts across hardware, firmware, and software layers to ensure successful product delivery. Your work will directly influence the reliability and performance of Meta's custom infrastructure chips at scale.

Minimum Qualifications:

6+ years of experience in ASIC/SoC development cycles with pre-silicon and/or post-silicon validation, hardware verification, or FPGA-based emulation for custom siliconExperience troubleshooting, debug, and analytics for silicon products, including debugging hardware-software interactions using waveform viewers, logic analyzers, and hardware debug probesExperience with ASIC design or development, emulation, and post-silicon validationExperience developing automation scripts and test infrastructure in Python, C/C++,Experience collaborating with internal and external partners across RTL design, verification, firmware, software, and systems teams in a custom silicon environment

Preferred Qualifications:
